recipes.title: Mediterranean Chicken Wraps
recipes.subtitle: with crunchy basil slaw & creamy tzatziki dip
recipes.description: These Mediterranean chicken wraps will take your taste buds on a real getaway! Whole wheat tortillas slathered with a crisp tzatziki, filled with yogurt marinated chicken, a crunchy basil, feta and sundried tomato slaw and fresh dill. Talk about perfection!

instructions.title: MARINATION STATION
instructions.text: Place the Spanish rub and 1/3 of the yoghurt in a bowl with a drizzle of oil and mix to combine. Add in the chicken mini fillets, toss to coat, and set aside to marinate.

instructions.title: ONION PERFECTION!
instructions.text: Place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the sliced onion for 8-9 minutes until soft and caramelised, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion, cover, and set aside to keep warm.

instructions.title: DREAMY TZATZIKI & SLAW
instructions.text: In a bowl combine the diced cucumber, 1/2 the chopped dill, the remaining yoghurt and 10ml of olive oil. Mix to combine, season and set aside. In a separate bowl, toss the shredded cabbage, drained crumbled feta, sun-dried tomatoes and basil pesto together, season to taste and set aside.

instructions.title: YOU'RE ALMOST THERE...
instructions.text: Place a nonstick pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the chicken mini fillets for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove from the heat on completion and set aside to rest for a few minutes.

instructions.title: HEAT THOSE WRAPS!
instructions.text: Place a clean pan over a medium heat. When hot, dry toast the tortillas one at a time for 30-60 seconds per side until heated and lightly crisped. Remove from the pan on completion.

instructions.title: LET'S WRAP IT UP!
instructions.text: Spread the tortilla with homemade tzatziki then fill with the mediterranean coleslaw, top with caramelised onions, chicken fillets and garnish with the remaining dill. Easy feasting!

recipes.chef_tip: Caramelised onions reach their full potential when sliced finely and cooked slowly. If you have the time, fry yours over a low heat for an extra 10-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pomodoro Pasta & Chicken Parm
recipes.subtitle: with fresh linguine & grated Italian-style hard cheese
recipes.description: If you want to put Italy on a plate, then Pasta al pomodoro is your go-to recipe. Our dish features delish chicken parm, covered in a crispy coating, then smothered in a rich tomato sauce and topped with melted Italian-style cheese. Sided with comforting pomodoro pasta and fresh basil. Mi scusi, Chef, can I have some more?

instructions.title: MA-KE DE SAUCE
instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to boil for the pasta. Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place a pan over medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the sliced onion and fry for 5-7 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally. Add the grated garlic and the tomato paste. Fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly. Add the tomato passata, the rub, and 300ml of water. Simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened. Add a sweetener of choice (to taste) and seasoning. Set aside.

instructions.title: A PAT ON THE BACK
instructions.text: Pat the chicken dry with paper towel and place on a chopping board. Using a sharp knife, slice into one side of each breast, starting at the thicker side and ending at the thinner point (be careful not to cut all the way through). Open each breast so that it resembles a butterfly. Cover with cling wrap and pummel with a rolling pin or bottle to create an even thickness. Season.

instructions.title: THAT CRUNCHY CRUMB
instructions.text: Whisk 2 eggs in a shallow dish with a splash of water. Prepare 2 more shallow dishes; one containing the breadcrumbs and the other containing the flour (lightly seasoned). Lightly coat each breast in the flour, then the egg mixture, and, lastly, the crumb. Set aside.

instructions.title: SAUCY AND CHEESY
instructions.text: Place a pan over medium-high heat with enough oil to cover the base. When hot, add the crumbed chicken and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until golden. Drain on paper towel and place on a greased baking tray. Top with ⅓ of the pomodoro sauce and ½ the grated cheese. Bake in the hot oven for 8-10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked through.

instructions.title: LOVELY LINGUINE
instructions.text: When the water is boiling, cook the pasta for 2-3 minutes until al dente. Drain, reserving a cup of pasta water, and toss through the remaining pomodoro sauce. Loosen with a splash of the reserved pasta water, if necessary. Place over a medium heat to reheat, if necessary. In a bowl, toss the rinsed green leaves with a drizzle of olive oil and seasoning.

instructions.title: IT'S TIME FOR ITALIAN!
instructions.text: Plate up the pomodoro pasta. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese. Side with the chicken parm and the dressed leaves. Garnish with the sliced basil and a crack of black pepper. Dig in!

recipes.chef_tip: If you have an air fryer, why not use it to cook the chicken parm? Pop a piece of tinfoil in the air fryer. Add the fried chicken topped with ⅓ of the sauce and ½ the grated cheese. Cook at 200°C for 4-5 minutes or until the cheese has melted.
recipes.obscured_details: Ring binder clip partially obscures the end of Chef's Tip ('melted') and the Allergens list ('Wheat').

recipes.title: Ricotta-Stuffed Chicken Breast
recipes.subtitle: with sun-dried tomatoes, a red quinoa salad & Dijon dressing
recipes.description: Juicy baked chicken, infused with the refreshing flavours of a creamy ricotta and sun-dried tomato stuffing. With a jumble of roast chickpeas and tomatoes, parsley, and quinoa for wholehearted Mediterranean nourishment.

ingredients.name: Sun-dried Tomatoes
ingredients.prep: drained & roughly chopped, reserving the oil

instructions.title: SPICY ROAST CHICKPEAS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the drained chickpeas in a deep roasting tray. Coat in oil, seasoning, and the Spanish Rub to taste. Spread out in a single layer and roast in the hot oven for 20-25 minutes until crispy.

instructions.title: RUBY RED QUINOA
instructions.text: Rinse the quinoa and place in a pot. Submerge in 600ml of salted water, place over a medium-high heat, and bring to a simmer uncovered. Cook for 20-25 minutes until the quinoa is fluffy and the tails have popped out, adding more water if required during the cooking process. On completion, drain if necessary and return to the pot. Cover with a lid and allow to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: PREP THE CHICKY
instructions.text: In a bowl, mix the reserved sun-dried tomato oil with the ricotta until well combined. Mix in the chopped sun-dried tomatoes and some seasoning. Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towel and place on a chopping board. Where the flesh is thicker, make a small, horizontal incision along the side of each breast. Using your fingers or a knife, gently pull the flesh apart to make little pockets for the stuffing.

instructions.title: INFUSE THE CHICKY
instructions.text: Transfer the breasts to a lightly greased baking tray and stuff the pockets with ricotta filling – don't worry if it spills out. Scatter the rinsed baby tomatoes around them, drizzle over some oil, and season. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the tomatoes are blistered.

instructions.title: HEARTY QUINOA SALAD
instructions.text: Combine the Dijon dressing with the juice of 3 lemon wedges and season to taste. When the chickpeas are crispy, remove from the oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes before adding the cooked quinoa to the tray. Be careful in case it's still hot! Add in ¾ of the chopped parsley, some lemon zest to taste, and any leftover ricotta stuffing if you'd like. Toss together with the Dijon dressing to taste. In a bowl, toss the rinsed salad leaves with a drizzle of oil and some seasoning.

instructions.title: LOAD UP & TUCK IN!
instructions.text: Make a bed of jam-packed quinoa and scatter with the roast tomatoes. Place the stuffed chicken on top and pour over any juices from its tray. Side with the dressed leaves and sprinkle over the remaining chopped parsley and lemon zest to taste. Delish!

recipes.chef_tip: To make the salad dressing, place the ingredients in a clean jar, close the lid tight, and shake, shake, shake! Using a jar emulsifies the dressing much better than just mixing it in a bowl!
recipes.obscured_details: Ring binder partially covers 'than' in Chef's Tip.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Roast Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with pearled spelt, blistered baby tomatoes & Pesto Princess Chimichurri
recipes.description: An easy tex-mex number to spur you on towards the weekend! Crispy roast chicken pieces coupled with wholesome spelt, a chunky black bean and corn chilli, lime-tossed leaves, and drizzles of chimichurri.

ingredients.name: Spring Onion
ingredients.prep: finely sliced, keeping the white & green parts separate

instructions.title: GET THE SPELT ON THE GO
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the spelt, place in a pot with the stock, and submerge in 500ml of water. Stir through, pop on a lid, and place over a medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer with the lid slightly ajar for 30-40 minutes until tender but still bouncy. Stir occasionally as the water is absorbed, only adding more if required during the cooking process. Remove from the heat on completion and drain if necessary.

instructions.title: POP THE CHICKEN IN TO ROAST
instructions.text: Place the chicken on a roasting tray and pat dry with paper towel. Coat in oil, half of the Mexican spice blend, and seasoning to taste. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and becoming crispy. Place the halved baby tomatoes in a bowl with a drizzle of oil and some seasoning. Toss to coat and set aside for step 4.

instructions.title: MEXI VEGGIES
instructions.text: Place a pan over a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the corn for 4-5 minutes until charred. Stir through the remaining Mexican spice blend, the white spring onion slices, and the drained black beans. Fry for 2-3 minutes until fragrant and heated through. Remove the pan from the heat and cover to keep warm until serving.

instructions.title: BLISTERED TOMATOES
instructions.text: When the chicken reaches the halfway mark, remove the tray from the oven and scatter around the dressed baby tomatoes. Return to the oven for the remaining roasting time until blistered.

instructions.title: JUST BEFORE SERVING...
instructions.text: Place the rinsed green leaves in a bowl with a drizzle of oil, a pinch of lime zest, and some lime juice to taste. Season and toss to coat. Loosen the chimichurri with 1 tbsp of olive oil and season to taste.

instructions.title: SHINING TEX-MEX DINING!
instructions.text: Make a bed of dressed leaves. Load up with the pearled spelt and the spicy corn and beans. Top with the roast chicken and drizzle over the chimichurri. Garnish with the green spring onion slices and any remaining lime wedges. Nice work, Chef!

recipes.title: Warwick's Creamy Chicken Korma
recipes.subtitle: with green beans, brown basmati & a tomato sambal
recipes.description: The curry go-to you can't say no to! Succulent mini fillets poached in a creamy, coconut-based korma sauce. Thickened with almond flour for a hint of nuttiness, popping with fresh ginger and chilli, and filled with soft baby tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Spice and All Things Nice Korma Curry Paste

instructions.title: COOK THE BASMATI
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot with half of the stock. Submerge in 500ml of water and stir through. Place over a medium-high heat and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. Drain on completion if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: KORMA CURRY
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Dilute the remaining stock with 125ml of boiling water. Place a pot for the curry over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry half of the diced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add in the grated ginger, and stir through the curry paste and sliced chilli to taste. Mix in the almond flour and half of the quartered baby tomatoes and cook for 4-5 minutes, shifting regularly. Pour in the diluted stock and the coconut cream, and stir until combined. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 4-5 minutes until thick and fragrant.

instructions.title: WHILE THE CURRY IS SIMMERING...
instructions.text: Make the sambal! Place the remaining tomato and onion in a bowl with three-quarters of the chopped coriander. Toss together with a drizzle of oil, some seasoning, and any remaining sliced chilli if you'd like. Set aside for serving.

instructions.title: OPTIONAL STEP TO BLEND THE SAUCE
instructions.text: Once the sauce has finished simmering, remove from the heat and pour into a blender. Blend until smooth and return to the pot over a low heat.

instructions.title: SAUCY CHICKEN & GREEN BEANS
instructions.text: Rinse the chicken to get rid of any residue from the packet and pat dry with paper towel. Submerge in the sauce along with the sliced green beans. Simmer for another 6-8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the beans are al dente, stirring occasionally. On completion, season to taste with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice. Remove the pot from the heat.

instructions.title: SILKY KORMA CURRY
instructions.text: Dish up the nutty rice and spoon over the chicken korma. Serve with the bright tomato sambal and garnish with the remaining chopped coriander. Delicious!

recipes.chef_tip: Ginger has superpowers! It strengthens the immune system, stops inflammation, eases digestion, and alleviates cold and flu symptoms. Whizz it up fresh with smoothies or juices for extra zing, or add it to just about any curry dish!
recipes.obscured_details: Ring binder partially covers 'add' in Chef's Tip.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken & Cowboy Salsa
recipes.subtitle: with heirloom corn nachos & sour cream
recipes.description: This culinary experience is like lassoing a rainbow. A loaded salsa of black beans, fresh tomato, charred corn, avo, pickled pepper, red onion, coriander, & a zesty lemon vinaigrette is served with a juicy chicken breast, sour cream, and crunchy heirloom corn nachos for scooping. It'll have you sayin' "Yee-haw!"

instructions.title: CHARRED CORN
instructions.text: Place a pan (that has a lid) over a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the corn and fry for 3-4 minutes until lightly charred, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: HAVO SOME AVO
instructions.text: Halve the avocado and remove the pip. Peel off the skin and roughly dice. Squeeze over the juice of 2 lemon wedges, season, and set aside.

instructions.title: HOWDY, CHICKY!
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towel. When the pan is hot, fry the chicken, skin-side down, for 4-6 minutes until golden. Flip, pop on the lid, and fry for 3-5 minutes until cooked through. During the final 1-2 minutes, baste with a knob of butter and ⅔ of the spice blend. Remove from the heat and rest in the pan for 5 minutes before slicing and seasoning.

instructions.title: COWBOY SALSA
instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the juice of 2 lemon wedges, a drizzle of oil, the remaining rub, a sweetener of choice (to taste), and seasoning. In a salad bowl, add the charred corn, the diced tomato, the rinsed black beans, the chopped pickled peppers, the dressed avo, the diced onion (to taste), and ½ the picked coriander. Drizzle over the lemon vinaigrette (to taste) and toss until combined.

instructions.title: PLATE UP!
instructions.text: Plate up the sliced chicken and top with a dollop of sour cream and the remaining picked coriander. Serve with the cowboy salsa and the nachos for scooping. Enjoy, Partner!

recipes.chef_tip: If you have some extra time, shred the chicken after it has been cooked and toss it through the salsa!

recipes.title: Caprese Stuffed Chicken Breast
recipes.subtitle: with a roasted carrot and baby marrow salad & a balsamic vinaigrette
recipes.description: This visually stunning dish boasts all the colours of the Italian flag - green basil pesto, rounds of ruby tomatoes, and melted mozzarella. Sided with the succulent stuffed chicken breast is a roasted veggie & almond salad and a drizzle of homemade mustard-maple balsamic vinaigrette. It's a culinary work of art, Chef!

ingredients.name: Baby Marrow
ingredients.prep: rinsed, trimmed & cut into bite-sized chunks

instructions.title: GET THE VEGGIE SALAD STARTED
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread out the carrot wedges and baby marrow chunks on a roasting tray, coat in oil, and season. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and crisping up, shifting halfway. When there are 3 minutes remaining, sprinkle over the chopped almonds and roast for the remaining time.

instructions.title: NOW FOR THE CAPRESE CHICKEN
instructions.text: Combine half of the sliced basil with the mozzarella. Pat the chicken breasts dry with some paper towel and place on a chopping board. Using a sharp knife, slice into one side of the breast, starting at the thicker end and ending at the thin point (be careful not to cut all the way through to the other side.) Open out the breast so that it resembles a butterfly. Cover with cling wrap and pummel with a rolling pin or bottle to create an even thickness. Season the inside of the chicken. Layer 2-3 tomato rounds and a spoonful of mozzarella and basil mixture onto the one side of the breast. Fold the other side of the breast over the filling to close it back up. Repeat with the other breasts.

instructions.title: GET THAT GOLDEN GLOW
instructions.text: Season the outside of the chicken and drizzle over a little oil. Place the stuffed chicken breasts on a separate roasting tray, and roast in the hot oven for 12-15 minutes until cooked through and golden.

instructions.title: IT'S ALL IN THE SAUCE
instructions.text: Place the pesto in a small bowl. Add oil or water in 5ml increments until a drizzling consistency. Set aside. In another bowl, add the mustard, maple syrup, balsamic vinegar, a drizzle of oil, and some seasoning. Mix to combine and set aside.

instructions.title: AND THE BEST DRESSED GOES TO...
instructions.text: Toss together the shredded salad leaves, the roasted veggies, the remaining basil, and the balsamic vinaigrette. Season to taste.

instructions.title: THERE'S A SURPRISE INSIDE!
instructions.text: Plate up the caprese stuffed chicken breasts and drizzle over the pesto. Side with the dressed carrot & baby marrow salad. Enjoy, Chef!

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.subtitle: with homemade sourdough croutons, hard cheese shavings & fresh chives
recipes.description: Nothing refreshes like the crispy textures and tangy flavours of a Caesar salad. Whip up your very own freshly toasted croutons and a classic Caesar dressing of Dijon mustard, lemon, hard cheese, and anchovies. Stylish and delish!

instructions.title: WHIZZ THE CAESAR DRESSING
instructions.text: Measure out 200ml of oil. Using a peeler, shave a quarter of the hard cheese into ribbons and set aside for garnish. Grate the remainder and place in a blender with the Dijon & Lemon and half of the grated garlic. Add in 2 egg yolks, three-quarters of the drained anchovy pieces, and a splash of the 200ml of oil. Blend the dressing, stopping at regular intervals to add the oil in small increments until used up. On completion, it should be thick and creamy. Gradually whisk in warm water until drizzling consistency. Season and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: BEANS & PEAS
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place a pot over a high heat, fill with boiling water, and add a pinch of salt. Once boiling rapidly, blanch the sliced green beans for 2-3 minutes until cooked al dente. In the last 30 seconds, pop in the peas to plump them up. Drain on completion, run under cold water to stop the cooking process, and set aside.

instructions.title: TOAST THE CROUTONS
instructions.text: Place the remaining grated garlic in a bowl with 60ml of olive oil and a pinch of salt. Toss through the sourdough chunks until coated. Place a large pan (that has a lid) over a medium heat. When hot, toast the sourdough for 3-4 minutes until crispy, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and allow to drain on paper towel. You may need to do this step in batches for the crispiest results.

instructions.title: BUTTERY CHICKEN
instructions.text: Pat the chicken breasts dry with some paper towel and season. Wipe down the pan and return it to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the chicken skin-side down for 5-7 minutes until crispy. Flip, pop on the lid, and fry for a further 5-7 minutes until cooked through. During the final 1-2 minutes, baste the chicken with a knob of butter. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

instructions.title: TOSS IT UP
instructions.text: Place the green beans, peas, and shredded lettuce in a bowl with as many croutons as you'd like. Toss through a small drizzle of Caesar dressing, reserving the remainder for plating.

instructions.title: YOUR CAESAR SALAD IS SERVED!
instructions.text: Pile up some crunchy salad and top with the golden chicken slices. Scatter over the hard cheese shavings and the remaining anchovy pieces. Drizzle with the Caesar dressing to taste and garnish with the fresh, chopped chives. Look at that, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: To cook food 'al dente' means that it should still be firm when bitten. It must be tender, but not soft. This typically refers to pasta, but applies to other grains, as well as a range of veg. In the case of your green beans, they should still have a snap to them once cooked.

recipes.title: Pesto-Infused Chicken Breast
recipes.subtitle: with a butternut, baby tomato, feta & quinoa salad
recipes.description: It's as wholesome as it is delish! Golden, pan-fried breast basted with rich basil pesto and set atop quinoa, roast butternut, blistered baby tomatoes, and spinach. Sprinkled with pumpkin seeds, creamy feta, and fresh parsley.

ingredients.name: Butternut
ingredients.prep: deseeded, peeled & cut into bite-size chunks

instructions.title: GET ROASTIN'
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Place the butternut chunks and rinsed baby tomatoes in a deep roasting tray. Coat in oil, season, and spread out evenly. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes, shifting halfway. On completion, the butternut should be cooked through and the tomatoes should have blistered.

instructions.title: PUT THE QUINOA ON
instructions.text: Rinse the quinoa and place in a pot. Submerge in 400ml of salted water, place over a medium-high heat, and bring to a simmer uncovered. Cook for 12-15 minutes until the quinoa is fluffy and the tails have popped out, adding more water if required during cooking. On completion, drain if necessary and return to the pot. Cover with a lid and allow to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: POPPIN' SEEDS
instructions.text: Place a pan that has a lid over a medium heat. When hot, toast the pumpkin seeds for 3-5 minutes until beginning to pop and turn brown. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: PESTO CHICKEN
instructions.text: When the roast reaches the halfway mark, return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. Pat the chicken dry with paper towel. When the pan is hot, fry the chicken for 5-7 minutes on one side until golden. Flip, pop on the lid, and fry for a further 5-7 minutes until cooked through. During the final minute, baste with ¾ of the basil pesto and a knob of butter. Remove from the heat and allow to rest in the pan for 5 minutes before slicing and lightly seasoning. Reserve the pan juices for serving.

instructions.title: TOSS THE SALAD
instructions.text: When the roast is ready, remove from the oven and add the cooked quinoa and rinsed spinach to the tray. If your tray isn't big enough, simply transfer the ingredients to a salad bowl. Toss together until the spinach has wilted and the tomatoes have split. Be careful, the tray will be hot! Pour over the vinegar to taste and crumble in ¾ of the drained feta. Toss again and season to taste.

instructions.title: TIME TO DEVOUR!
instructions.text: Pile up the quinoa jumble and top with the slices of pesto chicken. Dollop with the remaining pesto and drizzle over the pan juices to taste. Garnish with the remaining feta, the toasted pumpkin seeds, and the chopped parsley. That looks scrumptious, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: Spinach is rich in vitamin K. This micronutrient is vital for wound healing, bone health, important cognitive functions, and lowering blood pressure. Add spinach to sauces or smoothies for vitamin K kick!

recipes.title: Sleek & Simple Butter Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with nutty basmati, greek yoghurt & a crispy poppadom
recipes.description: Get that creamy, aromatic butter chicken curry experience — with none of the guilt! Thickened with greek yoghurt, loaded with baby spinach, and paired with nourishing brown basmati rice.

ingredients.name: Spice And All Things Nice Butter Chicken Curry Paste

instructions.title: GET THE BASMATI GOING
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot over a medium-high heat. Submerge in 800ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. Drain on completion if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: MARINATING & TOASTING
instructions.text: In a large bowl, mix together 2 tsp of the curry paste, a drizzle of oil, and some seasoning to taste. Rinse the chicken mini fillets to get rid of any residue from the packet, pat dry with paper towel, and add to the bowl. Toss until coated and set aside to marinate. Place the flaked almonds in a small pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden brown, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: CURRY BASE
instructions.text: Place a large pot over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the grated garlic and the remaining curry paste to taste, and fry for another minute until fragrant, shifting constantly. Pour in the cooked chopped tomatoes and 200ml of water. Give it a stir, bring to a simmer, and pop on a lid. Cook for 15-20 minutes until thickened.

instructions.title: CRISPY POPPADOM
instructions.text: When the sauce is nearing completion, return the pan to a medium-high heat with enough oil to cover the base. When hot, shallow fry the poppadoms one at a time for 30 seconds per side. As soon as it starts curling, use tongs or a spatula to flip it and flatten it out. Keep flipping and flattening until puffed up and golden. Remove from the pan on completion and drain on some paper towel.

instructions.title: THINGS ARE ABOUT TO GET CREAMY...
instructions.text: Once the sauce has thickened, stir through the yoghurt and marinated chicken. Replace the lid and simmer for 7-8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, giving it a stir halfway. During the final minute, stir through the rinsed baby spinach until wilted. Season to taste and remove from the heat on completion.

instructions.title: GRUB'S UP!
instructions.text: Make a bed of nutty basmati and smother in the creamy butter chicken curry. Garnish with the toasted almond flakes, chopped mint, and sliced spring onion. Scoop up all of that flavour with the crispy poppadoms. Good work, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: If you don't feel like frying the poppadoms, you can cook them in the microwave! Simply heat them one at a time in 10 second bursts. Do this until puffed up and crispy — about 30-40 seconds in total.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Paprika Pasta
recipes.subtitle: with mushrooms, fresh cream & grated Italian-style hard cheese
recipes.description: Chicken is cooked until golden and tender and laid on top of conchiglie pasta mixed with a paprika-infused cream sauce with mushrooms and white wine for even more richness. Sprinkles of grated Italian-style cheese take it over the top, making it a dish that you'll crave again and again.
recipes.wine_pairing: Waterford Estate | Waterford Pecan Stream Chenin Blanc 2021

instructions.title: PERFECT PASTA
instructions.text: Boil a full kettle. Place a pot for the pasta over high heat. Fill with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and bring back up to the boil. When boiling, cook the pasta for 8-10 minutes until al dente. Drain, reserving a cup of pasta water, and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: SEARED CHICKEN
instructions.text: While the pasta is boiling, place a pan with a lid over medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towel. When the pan is hot, fry the chicken on one side for 4-6 minutes until golden. Flip, pop on the lid, and fry for 4-6 minutes until cooked through. During the final 1-2 minutes, baste with a knob of butter. Remove from the pan and set aside to rest for 5 minutes before slicing and seasoning. Cover to keep warm.

instructions.title: WHILE THE CHICKEN IS COOKING...
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the quartered mushrooms and fry for 6-7 minutes until golden. Remove from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: CREAMY PAPRI SAUCE
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the grated garlic, the tomato paste, and the wine. Cook for 1-2 minutes or until almost all evaporated. Add 80g of butter and the flour. Fry for 1-2 minutes, shifting constantly. Remove from the heat and gradually stir in the cream, making sure there are no lumps. Loosen the sauce with the reserved pasta water until the desired consistency.

instructions.title: WHEN IT ALL COMES TOGETHER
instructions.text: Return the pan with the sauce to a medium-high heat and bring to a simmer. Add the paprika, the lemon juice (to taste), the cooked pasta, the cooked mushrooms, ½ the grated cheese, ½ the chopped parsley, a sweetener of choice (to taste), and seasoning. Mix until combined and remove from the heat.

instructions.title: PLATE IT UP
instructions.text: Plate up the creamy paprika pasta and sprinkle over the remaining cheese. Top with the chicken slices and garnish with the remaining parsley. Indulge yourself, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: If you have an air fryer, why not use it to cook the chicken? Coat in oil, season, and pop in the air fryer at 200°C. Cook for 10-12 minutes until cooked through and browned. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: ONE-POT CHICKEN CURRY
recipes.subtitle: with coriander and chilli pesto & whole wheat rotis
recipes.description: There’s nothing like a speedy, minimal-mess curry and an easy-peasy raita to end off a busy day. With lean protein from chicken mini fillets and complex carbs from roast sweet potato, it’ll leave you nourished and cosy to the core.

instructions.title: ROAST THE SWEET POTATO
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread out the sweet potato pieces on a roasting tray, coat in oil, and season. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and crisping up, shifting halfway.

instructions.title: START YOUR CURRY
instructions.text: Place a large pot for the curry over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the sliced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the grated ginger and stir in the chopped chilli and the Indian Rub (both to taste). Fry for about a minute until fragrant, shifting continuously. Pour in the cooked chopped tomatoes, then fill the tomato can with 350ml of water. Swirl it around to catch the remaining tomato and add to the pot. Reduce to a low heat and pop on a lid. Allow to simmer for 10-12 minutes until slightly reduced, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: CHICKEN PREP & CUCUMBER RAITA
instructions.text: While the curry is simmering, rinse the chicken mini fillets to get rid of any residue and pat dry with some paper towel. Place in a bowl with a drizzle of oil and seasoning to taste. Toss to coat and set aside. Grate the cucumber onto some paper towel or a dish cloth and squeeze to remove any excess liquid. Place the yoghurt and grated cucumber in a bowl, season to taste, and mix to combine. Set aside for serving.

instructions.title: COMPLETE THE CURRY
instructions.text: When the curry has finished simmering, add in the chicken and the halved green beans. Stir to coat and replace the lid. Simmer for a further 7-8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the green beans are al dente. In the final 1-2 minutes, stir through the roast sweet potato, season to taste, and remove from the heat.

instructions.title: ROTI TIME
instructions.text: Place a dry pan over a medium heat. When hot, warm the rotis for about 1 minute per side until heated through and lightly toasted. Alternatively, spread them out on a plate in a single layer and heat up in the microwave for 30-60 seconds, or heat up in the oven for 2-3 minutes.

instructions.title: BOWL UP!
instructions.text: Spoon some fragrant chicken curry into a bowl. Add generous dollops of the cucumber raita and the coriander & chilli pesto. Serve the rotis on the side and use them to scoop up all that deliciousness. Yum!

recipes.chef_tip: Ginger has superpowers! It strengthens the immune system, stops inflammation, eases digestion, and alleviates cold and flu symptoms. Whizz it up fresh with smoothies or juices for extra zing, or add it to just about any curry dish!

recipes.title: Bunless Moroccan Chicken Burgers
recipes.subtitle: with spiced roast pumpkin & a hummus and pomegranate dressing
recipes.description: The familiar delight of a juicy, well-spiced burger, but with none of the guilt of a bun! These chicken patties are flavoured with Moroccan spices and paired with roast pumpkin, crispy lentils, and drips of hummus dressing.

instructions.title: FRAGRANT PUMPKIN
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread out the pumpkin pieces on a roasting tray. Coat in oil, ½ of the Moroccan Rub, and some seasoning to taste. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes. Place the drained lentils in a bowl, coat in oil and seasoning, and set aside.

instructions.title: MAKE THE SPICED PATTIES
instructions.text: Place the mince and grated garlic in a bowl. Combine with the remaining Moroccan Rub to taste and lightly season. Wet your hands slightly to prevent the mince from sticking to them and shape into 4 patties of about 2cm thick. Set aside until frying.

instructions.title: BURGER BOWL BITS
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place the seeds in a nonstick pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until beginning to pop and turn brown. Remove from the pan on completion. Place the hummus in a bowl and mix in the pomegranate molasses to taste. Loosen with milk or water in 5ml increments until drizzling consistency and season to taste. Submerge the peas in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until plump and heated through. Drain on completion. Set the seeds, hummus, and peas aside for serving.

instructions.title: LOOKING GOOD...
instructions.text: When the pumpkin reaches the halfway mark, remove from the oven and give a shift. Scatter over the lentils, spread out in a single layer, and return to the oven for the remaining cooking time. On completion, the lentils should be crispy and the pumpkin should be cooked through and caramelised.

instructions.title: FRY THOSE BEAUTS!
instructions.text: When the roast veg has about 10 minutes remaining, return the pan to a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the patties for 4-5 minutes per side until golden. Remove from the heat on completion and allow to rest in the pan for 2-3 minutes before serving.

instructions.title: YOUR ULTIMATE BUNLESS BURGER
instructions.text: Dish up the crisp roast pumpkin and lentils next to the rinsed salad leaves. Scatter over the peas and top with the juicy chicken patties. Cover in sprinkles of toasted seeds and drizzles of hummus dressing. Garnish with the chopped mint and the sliced spring onion. Divine, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: To check if your patties are seasoned enough, fry a bite-size piece of the patty mixture with a drizzle of oil for 1-2 minutes until cooked. Taste and add more seasoning to the raw mixture if needed.

recipes.title: Crispy Cumin Coated Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with pumpkin chunks, chickpea salsa & sultanas
recipes.description: Lush, crispy, cumin-coated chicken pieces sit alongside chunky pumpkin. A spicy chickpea salsa with sweet pops of golden sultanas and a zip of fried garlic elevates this wholesomely chic dish to a whole new level. Quick and easy, simple and tasty!

instructions.title: START
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the chicken pieces on half of a roasting tray, toss with the cumin and oil, and season. Place the pumpkin pieces on the half of the roasting tray. Coat in oil, season, and spread out evenly. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and starting to crisp.

instructions.title: CRISPY CHICKPEAS
instructions.text: Place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the drained chickpeas for 12-15 minutes until crispy and golden in colour. For the best result, only shift occasionally. If they start to pop out, use a lid to rein them in! In the final 1-2 minutes, add the grated garlic, chopped sultanas, and fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly.

instructions.title: SPICY SALSA
instructions.text: Place the crispy chickpeas mixture in a bowl. Add the diced onion to taste, baby tomatoes, and ½ of the chopped coriander. Toss through sliced chilli, white wine vinegar, and seasoning – all to taste!

instructions.title: DELICIOUS DINNER
instructions.text: Plate up the pumpkin alongside the chicken and chickpea salsa. Garnish with the remaining coriander. Well done, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: To check if your chicken is ready, pierce it with a knife. If it’s cooked through, the juices will run clear.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Korma
recipes.subtitle: with coconut cream, brown basmati & a classic tomato sambal
recipes.description: The curry go-to you can't say no to! Succulent mini fillets poached in a creamy, coconut-based korma sauce. Thickened with almond flour for a hint of nuttiness, popping with fresh ginger and chilli, and filled with peas and soft baby tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Spice & All Things Nice Korma Curry Paste

instructions.title: NUTTY BASMATI
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot with ½ of the stock. Submerge in 800ml of water and stir through. Place over a medium-high heat and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. Drain on completion if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: GET THAT SAUCE GOING
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Dilute the remaining stock with 200ml of boiling water. Place a pot for the curry over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry ½ of the diced onion for 5-7 minutes until soft and translucent. Add in the grated ginger, then stir through the curry paste and sliced chilli (both to taste). Mix in the almond flour and ½ of the quartered baby tomatoes, and cook for 5-6 minutes, shifting regularly. Stir in the coconut cream and diluted stock until well combined. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 7-8 minutes until thick and fragrant.

instructions.title: WHILE THE CURRY IS SIMMERING...
instructions.text: Make the sambal! Place the remaining tomato and onion in a bowl with ¾ of the chopped coriander. Toss together with a drizzle of oil, some seasoning, and any remaining sliced chilli if you'd like. Set aside for serving.

instructions.title: BLEND UNTIL SILKY
instructions.text: Once the sauce has finished simmering, pour into a blender and blend until smooth. Return to the pot and place over a medium heat. (If you don't have a blender, you can just leave the sauce chunky!)

instructions.title: TENDER, SAUCY CHICKEN
instructions.text: Rinse the chicken to get rid of any residue from the packet and pat dry with paper towel. Submerge in the sauce and simmer for 7-8 minutes until cooked through, stirring occasionally. In the final 2 minutes, stir through the peas. On completion, season to taste with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice. Remove the pot from the heat.

instructions.title: YOUR FAVOURITE CREAMY CURRY
instructions.text: Pile up the steamy rice and spoon over the chicken korma. Garnish with the remaining coriander and serve with the bright tomato sambal on the side. Off you go, Chef!

recipes.title: Balti Chicken Curry
recipes.subtitle: with cashew nuts, coconut cream & spring onion
recipes.description: Have you been craving a smooth, aromatic lively chicken curry? This coconut cream thickened, spinach loaded, spring onion flecked, black rice based shibang is just the dish to satiate that very desire. Jazzed up with a crunch of buttery cashews and oh me, oh my, you're good to go!

ingredients.name: Spice & All Things Nice Balti Curry Paste

instructions.title: GET THE RICE GOING
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot with 600ml of salted water. Pop on a lid and place over a medium heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 30-35 minutes until the water has been absorbed. If it starts to dry out, add more water in small increments to continue cooking. On completion, it should be tender but bouncy. Remove from the heat and drain if necessary. Cover with the lid and set aside until serving.

instructions.title: MARINATING & TOASTING
instructions.text: In a medium-sized bowl, mix together ½ tsp of curry paste and a drizzle of oil. Pat the chicken pieces dry with paper towel, and add to the bowl. Toss until coated, season, and set aside to marinate. Place the cashews in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside. Roughly chop when cool enough to handle.

instructions.title: THE CURRY BASE
instructions.text: Place a pot for the curry over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onion and diced carrot for 2-3 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the grated garlic, the remaining curry paste and some chopped chilli, both to taste. Fry for 30-60 seconds until fragrant, shifting constantly. Stir in the cooked chopped tomato and 150ml of water. Bring to a simmer, pop on a lid, and cook for 10-12 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: THINGS ARE ABOUT TO GET CREAMY
instructions.text: Once the sauce has thickened, stir through the coconut cream and chicken pieces. Replace the lid and simmer for 6-7 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, giving it a stir halfway. During the final 1-2 minutes, stir through the shredded spinach and cook until wilted. Season to taste and remove from the heat on completion.

instructions.title: GRUB’S UP!
instructions.text: Make a bed of black rice and smother in creamy balti chicken curry. Garnish with the toasted cashew nuts, sliced spring onion and any remaining chilli. Wow, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: In Ancient China, black rice was believed to be superior to other types of rice due to its medicinal properties. During cooking, black rice releases a natural black dye, so we advise using a stainless steel pot.

recipes.title: Coconut Chicken & Rice
recipes.subtitle: with red bell pepper, spinach, & fresh coriander
recipes.description: This vibrant & creamy curry is made from tender pieces of chicken smothered in a thick coconut curry sauce consisting of red onions & peppers, ginger, tomato and fresh chilli. Balanced out with earthy spinach & fragrant coriander. All served with a generous helping of brown rice. What are you waiting for, Chef? Curry up and get cooking!

instructions.title: NICE RICE BABY
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot over medium-high heat. Submerge in 500ml of salted water and pop on the lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and steam for 10 minutes. Drain if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: GOLDEN CHICKY CHUNKS
instructions.text: Place a deep pan or pot over medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the chicken chunks and fry for 1-2 minutes until browned but not cooked through, shifting as it colours. Remove from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: AWESOME AROMATICS
instructions.text: Return the pan or pot to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the sliced onion, the sliced pepper, and the diced tomato. Fry for 6-7 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally. Add the grated ginger, 1/2 the sliced chilli (to taste), and the rub. Fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly.

instructions.title: CREAMY CURRY
instructions.text: When the chilli is fragrant, pour the coconut cream into the pot or pan. Simmer for 5-6 minutes until slightly thickened. In the final 1-2 minutes, add the browned chicken. Remove from the heat, stir through the rinsed spinach, 1/2 the picked coriander, a squeeze of lemon juice (to taste), a sweetener of choice (to taste), and seasoning. Loosen with a splash of warm water if it's too thick for your liking.

instructions.title: PLATE IT UP!
instructions.text: Dish up the rice and the fragrant coconut chicken. Garnish with the remaining coriander and chilli (to taste). Serve with any remaining lemon wedges. Indulge your senses, Chef!

recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Satay Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with mung bean noodles, coconut cream, tamari & fresh basil
recipes.description: No one can say no to a creamy satay sauce! Especially when made with spicy, artisanal peanut butter and smothering a tender chicken breast. Paired with a lively, saucy salad of slaw, green beans, and noodles, with notes of basil and lime.

instructions.title: LET'S GET GOING
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C on the grill setting and position the oven rack about 15cm from the top. Place the seeds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 2-4 minutes until light brown, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside. Pat the chicken dry with paper towel. Make wide, criss-cross incisions on its surface, cutting 1/3 of the way into the flesh. Season well and set aside.

instructions.title: COOK THE VERMICELLI
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Using a shallow bowl, submerge the noodles in boiling water and add a pinch of salt. Give a stir, cover with a plate, and set aside to soak for 6-8 minutes until cooked and glassy. Drain, toss through some oil to prevent sticking, and set aside in a salad bowl.

instructions.title: GROOVY GREEN BEANS
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and a splash of water. When bubbling, simmer the halved green beans for 3-4 minutes until cooked al dente. Drain on completion if necessary, season, and add to the bowl of noodles.

instructions.title: SATAY CHICKEN
instructions.text: Wipe down the pan and return it to a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the chicken scored-side down for 3-4 minutes until crisp. Flip and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden but not cooked through. Transfer to a lightly greased baking tray. Return the pan to a low-medium heat with another drizzle of oil. When hot, whisk in the peanut butter, tamari, honey, and 1/2 of the coconut cream until combined. Simmer for 1-2 minutes until slightly thickened, whisking regularly. Stir in the juice of 1 lime (to taste) and remove from the heat. Bend the breasts to open the slits and spoon over 1/4 of the sauce. Pop under the grill for 5-6 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.

instructions.title: ASSEMBLE THE SALAD
instructions.text: For the dressing, loosen the remaining satay sauce by whisking in the rest of the coconut cream. If too thick, gradually add water until drizzling consistency. Add the cabbage and carrot to the bowl of noodles and beans. Toss through the dressing, 3/4 of the toasted seeds, and 3/4 of the chopped basil. Season to taste.

instructions.title: A SILKY SUPPER!
instructions.text: Plate up the noodle salad and top with the peanut satay chicken. Garnish with the remaining seeds and basil, and serve with a lime wedge on the side. You did it, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: To cook food 'al dente' means that it should still be firm when bitten. It must be tender, but not soft. This typically refers to pasta, but also applies to other grains, as well as a range of veg. In the case of your green beans, they should still have a slight snap to them once cooked.
recipes.obscured_details: Ring binder hole partially obscures the word 'slight' ('sligh' punched out, 't' visible) in the Chef's Tip.

recipes.title: Thai Chicken Meatballs
recipes.subtitle: with coconut milk, basmati, curried butternut & fresh lime
recipes.description: The ideal blend of Thai flavours and healthy ingredients. A sauce made creamy with coconut milk, spicy with red curry paste, and nutritious with butternut, spinach, and brown basmati rice. Crowned with juicy, spice-infused chicken meatballs.

instructions.title: BUBBLE THE RICE
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the rice and place in a large pot with 800ml of salted water, cover, and place over a medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. On completion, drain if necessary and fluff up with a fork. Replace the lid and set aside to keep warm.

instructions.title: START THE SAUCE
instructions.text: Place a large pot for the curry over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté 3/4 of the diced onion for 5-6 minutes until soft and translucent. Mix in 2/3 of the curry paste (or to taste) and fry for another minute until fragrant, shifting constantly. Add the pumpkin pieces and fry for 3-4 minutes. Pour in the coconut milk and stir to incorporate. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pumpkin is tender.

instructions.title: GET HANDS-ON
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the mince with the Thai 7 spice to taste. Mix in the remaining onion to preference and season to taste. Wet your hands slightly to stop the mixture from sticking, and roll into 4-5 meatballs per portion. Place on a greased baking tray and coat in a little oil.

instructions.title: TOASTIN' & ROASTIN'
instructions.text: Place the cashews in a small pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside. Roughly chop when cool enough to handle. Pop the tray of meatballs in the hot oven and bake for 7-8 minutes until browned but not cooked through, shifting halfway. Remove from the oven on completion.

instructions.title: FINAL TOUCHES
instructions.text: Once the curry has thickened and the pumpkin has softened, mix in some more curry paste if you'd like it spicier. Stir through the shredded spinach and pop in the meatballs. Simmer for 4-5 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through, basting occasionally. Season to taste with lime juice, zest, salt, and pepper. Remove from the heat on completion. Toss 1/2 of the chopped coriander through the cooked rice.

instructions.title: BOWL UP!
instructions.text: Serve up some rice and spoon over the Thai curry and meatballs. Scatter over the diced pickled peppers, chopped cashews, and remaining coriander. Garnish with a lime wedge and get to it!

recipes.chef_tip: To check if your meatball mince mixture is seasoned enough, first fry a bite-sized piece for 1-2 minutes until cooked through. Taste to test and add more seasoning to the raw mixture if needed.

recipes.title: Temptations Minty Chicken Breyani
recipes.subtitle: with brown basmati, yoghurt & a unique blend of spices
recipes.description: A traditional breyani, packed with flavour from fresh herbs, chilli, and a Temptations Spice Blend to take it to the top of the yum scoreboard! With tender chicken breast and fragrant lentils featuring as the main characters, supported by steamy rice.

instructions.title: BREYANI RICE
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot over medium-high heat. Submerge in 500ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. On completion, drain if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: FRESH CORIANDER & MINT PASTE
instructions.text: Place the rinsed coriander, the grated garlic, and 1/2 of the mint leaves on a chopping board. Add 3/4 of the sliced chilli (or to taste) and finely chop until combined in a chunky paste. Place in a bowl (or a pestle and mortar if you have one) and mix in a drizzle of oil. Alternatively, you can combine these ingredients in a blender if you have one. Set aside for step 4. Pat the chicken dry with paper towel, slice into bite-sized chunks, and set aside.

instructions.title: TEMPER THE SPICES
instructions.text: Place a large pot over a medium-high heat with enough oil to cover the base. Once hot, fry the Temptations Spice Blend for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly. Mix in the diced onion and whole spices. Sauté for 4-6 minutes until the onion is soft. On completion, remove and discard the cinnamon sticks. Mix in the coriander-mint paste and a pinch of salt. Fry for another 4-5 minutes, shifting regularly.

instructions.title: ADD IN THE THE REST
instructions.text: When the spices have finished frying, stir through the drained lentils and chicken cubes, and fry for 3-4 minutes until the chicken is sealed but not cooked through, shifting occasionally. Lower the heat and cover with a lid for 4-5 minutes until the flavours have fully developed and the chicken is cooked through.

instructions.title: THE FINAL STEAM & THE FINAL MIX
instructions.text: Add in the cooked rice and gently toss for 1-2 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover with a lid, and set aside to dry out for 10 minutes. On completion, there should be no liquid remaining. Finely chop the remaining mint leaves and place in a bowl with the yoghurt. Mix to combine, season, and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: A MEAL TO BE PROUD OF!
instructions.text: Dish up a mound of fragrant chicken breyani. Dollop over the minty yoghurt and garnish with the remaining chilli to taste. Eat, drink, and be merry, because you earned it! (And watch out for those sneaky cardamom pods...)

recipes.chef_tip: Your mint and coriander have been packaged together to prevent the use of unnecessary extra plastic. If you struggle to tell the difference between them, do a quick online search to find some pics for reference!

recipes.title: Easy Thai Red Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with chicken mini fillets, toasted cashews & spinach
recipes.description: Don't let eating clean stop you from enjoying terrific textures and flirtatious flavours! You won't regret trying it!

instructions.title: NUTRITIOUS BASMATI
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot over medium-high heat. Submerge in 500ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. Drain on completion if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: TOASTY NUTS
instructions.text: Place the cashews in a pot over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pot on completion and set aside. Roughly chop when cool enough to handle.

instructions.title: THE CURRY IS A GO!
instructions.text: Return the pot to a medium-high heat. When hot, fry the sliced onion for 4-5 minutes until softened, shifting regularly. Add the curry paste to taste and fry for 30-60 seconds until fragrant, shifting constantly. Pour in the milk and gradually whisk in the cornflour until incorporated into the liquid. Bring to simmer and cook for 4-5 minutes until slightly reduced, stirring occasionally. Add the sliced green beans and allow to cook for another 8-10 minutes until the beans are al dente.

instructions.title: POP IN THAT CHICKEN
instructions.text: Once the sauce has thickened, rinse the chicken mini fillets to get rid of any residue from the packet and pat dry with paper towel. Add to the pot, fully submerge in sauce, and simmer for 5-6 minutes until cooked through. In the final minute, stir through the shredded spinach and cook for the remaining time until wilted. Remove from the heat on completion and season with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice to taste.

instructions.title: YOUR CURRY IS SERVED
instructions.text: Spoon some fragrant Thai red curry over a bed of nutty basmati. Sprinkle over the sliced chilli to taste and garnish with the chopped coriander and the chopped, toasted cashews. Well done, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: Always add curry paste to your taste preference – you don't have to add it all! When the sauce is nearing completion, taste to test the spice levels and gradually add in any remaining curry paste if you like to increase the heat.

recipes.title: Velvety Butter Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with almonds, coconut cream & a crispy poppadom
recipes.description: Get that smooth, aromatic butter chicken curry experience you’ve been craving. Thickened with coconut cream, loaded with spinach, flecked with fresh mint, and paired with nourishing brown basmati rice. This leaves for a dish that’s as comforting as it is beautiful.

instructions.title: GET THE BASMATI GOING
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot over a medium-high heat. Submerge in 800ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keep the lid on, remove from the heat, and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. Drain on completion if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: MARINATING & TOASTING
instructions.text: In a large bowl, mix together 2 tsps of curry paste and a drizzle of oil. Rinse the chicken fillets to get rid of any residue from the packet, pat dry with paper towel, and add to the bowl. Toss until coated, season, and set aside to marinate. Place the flaked almonds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden brown, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: THE CURRY BASE
instructions.text: Place a pot for the curry over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the grated garlic and the remaining curry paste to taste. Fry for 30-60 seconds until fragrant, shifting constantly. Stir in the cooked chopped tomato and 200ml of water. Bring to a simmer, pop on a lid, and cook for 20-25 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: GOLDEN POPPADOM/S
instructions.text: When the sauce has 5 minutes remaining, return the pan to a medium-high heat with enough oil to cover the base. When hot, fry the poppadoms for 30 seconds on one side. When starting to curl, use tongs or a spatula to flip and flatten out. Keep flipping and flattening until puffed up and golden. You may need to do this step in batches. Remove from the pan on completion and allow to drain on paper towel.

instructions.title: THINGS ARE ABOUT TO GET CREAMY...
instructions.text: Once the sauce has thickened, stir through the coconut cream and chicken pieces. Replace the lid and simmer for 7-8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, giving it a stir halfway. During the final minute, stir through the rinsed spinach until wilted. Season to taste and remove from the heat.

instructions.title: GRUB'S UP!
instructions.text: Make a bed of nutty basmati and smother in creamy butter chicken curry. Garnish with the toasted almond flakes, chopped mint, and sliced spring onion. Scoop it up with the with the crispy poppadoms. Wow, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: If you don't feel like frying the poppadoms, you can cook them in the microwave! Simply heat them one at a time in 10 second bursts. Do this until puffed up and crispy – about 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Chinese-style Cashew Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with green bell pepper & fresh coriander
recipes.description: The famous take-away dish, cashew chicken, gets a UCOOK revamp! Silky egg noodles are tossed with green bell pepper, chicken pieces, spring onion, and red onion. Doused in a tasty sauce loaded with oyster sauce, sesame oil, and soy sauce and sprinkled with fresh coriander, honestly what could be better?

ingredients.name: Oyster-soy Sauce
ingredients.prep: (10ml Sesame Oil, 50ml Oyster Sauce & 20ml Low Sodium Soy Sauce)

ingredients.name: Green Pepper
ingredients.prep: rinsed, deseeded & cut into small bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.prep: finely sliced, keeping the white & green parts separate

instructions.title: OODLES OF NOODLES
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Fill a pot for the noodles with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and place over a medium-high heat. Once boiling rapidly, cook the noodles for 7-8 minutes until al dente. Drain on completion and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: CA-SHEW! THANK YOU.
instructions.text: Place the cashew nuts in a large pan or wok over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside.

instructions.title: MIX & FRY
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the cornflour with 2 tbsp of water. Mix until a runny paste. Add the oyster-soy sauce, 40ml of water, and the grated garlic. Set aside.

instructions.title: CHEEKY CHICK
instructions.text: Return the pan or wok to a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the chicken chunks and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until browned and cooked through. Remove from the pan on completion and season to taste.

instructions.title: YOU WOK MY WORLD
instructions.text: Return the pan or wok to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the onion slices and fry for 3-4 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally. Add the pepper pieces and the spring onion whites. Fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened, shifting occasionally. Add the cooked chicken, the oyster garlic sauce, and 3/4 of the toasted cashews. Toss until fully combined. Leave to simmer for 1-2 minutes until slightly reduced, shifting occasionally. Loosen with a splash of water if it reduces too quickly. Remove from the heat, toss through the cooked noodles, and season to taste.

instructions.title: TAKE-AWAY AT HOME!
instructions.text: Bowl up the cashew chicken noodles. Top with the remaining cashew nuts, the spring onion greens, and the picked coriander. Get munching, Chef!

recipes.title: Sticky Vietnamese Chicken
recipes.subtitle: with jasmine rice, sautéed spinach & pickled edamame beans
recipes.description: Free-range chicken pieces reach peak performance with a delectably sticky marinade: a blend of honey, chilli, lime, soy, ginger, and garlic. It's full-spectrum flavour, completed by zesty jasmine rice and silky spinach.

instructions.title: STICKY CHICKEN MARINADE
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Boil the kettle for step 2. Combine the salty sauce with 2 tbsp of oil and half of the pickling liquid. Mix in the grated ginger and garlic, the juice of 4 lime wedges, and the chopped chilli to taste. Pat the chicken dry with some paper towel and place on a roasting tray. Pour over half of the marinade, toss to coat, and set aside to marinate for at least 10 minutes.

instructions.title: PICKLE THE VEGGIES
instructions.text: Submerge the edamame beans in boiling water for 1-2 minutes until heated. Drain on completion and place in a bowl with the sliced radish and the remaining pickling liquid. Toss to coat and set aside to pickle.

instructions.title: ROAST THE GLAZED CHICKEN
instructions.text: Once the chicken has marinated, roast in the hot oven for 35-40 minutes until cooked through and crispy. At the halfway mark, baste with the rest of the marinade and return to the oven for the remaining cooking time.

instructions.title: FLUFFY JASMINE RICE
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot over a medium-high heat. Submerge in 600ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes until the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. On completion, drain if necessary and fluff with a fork. Stir through the lime zest to taste, replace the lid, and set aside until serving.

instructions.title: SAUTÉ THE SPINACH
instructions.text: When the chicken has 5 minutes to go, place a pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the shredded spinach for 5-6 minutes until wilted. Remove from the pan on completion, season, and squeeze over the juice of 2 lime wedges.

instructions.title: REAP YOUR REWARDS
instructions.text: Make a bed of zesty rice. Top with the sautéed spinach, pickled veggies, and glazed chicken. Spoon over any remaining marinade from the tray and garnish with any remaining lime zest and chilli to taste. Good work, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: The longer you marinate the meat, the better! So, if time is on your side, complete the marinating step an hour or two before you plan to start cooking. You can even marinate it in the fridge overnight!

recipes.title: Moroccan-Spiced Hake
recipes.subtitle: with avocado hummus & roast carrot and chickpeas
recipes.description: Easy as pie, but far healthier than pie! Crispy roast chickpeas and carrots bring the crunch; flakey hake brings the softness; spices, lemon, and rocket bring the zing; and avo hummus brings it all together.

instructions.title: ROAST CHICKPEAS & CARROTS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Place the drained chickpeas and carrot rounds on a roasting tray. Spread out in a single layer, coat in oil, and season. Roast in the hot oven for 25-30 minutes until the chickpeas are crispy and the carrots have softened.

instructions.title: MOROCCAN MARINADE
instructions.text: Place the hake fillets in a large bowl and pat dry with some paper towel. Coat in oil, the Moroccan Rub, a squeeze of lemon juice, and some seasoning. Set aside to marinate for about 10 minutes.

instructions.title: TOAST THE SEEDS
instructions.text: Place the pumpkin seeds in a large pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until they begin to pop and turn brown. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: SALAD LOVE
instructions.text: Place the rinsed green leaves, sliced radish, and toasted pumpkin seeds in a salad bowl. Add some lemon zest to taste, a drizzle of oil, and some seasoning. Toss together and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: TASTY, FLAKY HAKE
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with some oil and a knob of butter (optional). When hot, fry the spiced hake skin-side down for 3-4 minutes until the skin is crispy and golden. Flip and fry the other side for 3-4 minutes until cooked through. Remove from the pan on completion.

instructions.title: TIME TO DINE
instructions.text: Plate up some crispy chickpeas and caramelised carrots. Lay the Moroccan-spiced hake fillet on top and dollop with the avo hummus. Serve the fresh, crunchy salad on the side. Finally, garnish with the rinsed mint leaves and a lemon wedge. Magnificent, Chef!

recipes.title: Trout & Patatas Bravas
recipes.subtitle: with garlic That Mayo & a fresh salad
recipes.description: If you like the simple flavours of crispy potato fries dipped in tomato sauce, you will love patatas bravas. This popular Spanish dish takes those well-known flavours to the next level. By adding a flavoursome trout to the plate, a dash of mayo and a refreshing salad, your palate will be doing the Paso Doble.

instructions.title: PARBOILED POTATOES
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the halved baby potatoes in a pot of salted water over high heat and pop on the lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until easily pierced with a fork.

instructions.title: A SMOKIN' SAUCE
instructions.text: Place a pan over medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the diced onion and fry for 4-5 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally. Add the grated garlic and the smoked paprika (to taste). Fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly. Add the cooked chopped tomato, 80ml of water, and a sweetener of choice (to taste). Bring to a simmer and cook for 8-10 minutes until slightly thickened. Add an extra splash of water if it reduces too quickly. Season and stir through 3/4 of the chopped chives. Cover to keep warm.

instructions.title: SMASH, THEN SEASON
instructions.text: When the potatoes are done, drain the water. Place the potatoes on a roasting tray and spread out in a single layer. Using a fork, gently press down to slightly smash them and create a few cracks. Coat in oil, the spice blend, and seasoning. Roast in the hot oven for 10-15 minutes until golden, shifting halfway.

instructions.title: GOING ALL-OUT WITH TROUT
instructions.text: Place the trout fillet, skin-side down, on a greased baking tray (or the tray with the potatoes) and place in the hot oven for 10-15 minutes until cooked through.

instructions.title: A SIDE OF SALAD
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the rinsed salad leaves, the halved baby tomatoes, a drizzle of oil, and seasoning. In a separate bowl, loosen the mayo with water in 5ml increments until slightly loosened.

instructions.title: BUEN PROVECHO!
instructions.text: Plate up the trout fillets. Side with the crispy potatoes smothered in the tomato sauce. Drizzle over the loosened mayo. Serve with the tomato salad and garnish with the remaining chives. What a feast, Chef!

recipes.title: Seaside Cajun Hake
recipes.subtitle: with roast baby potatoes, fresh lemon & a classic tartar sauce
recipes.description: This tasty number will whisk you off to a sunny shore with a cool sea breeze. Grilled hake, flavoured with Cajun spice, is deliciously at ease with its longtime friends: crispy potatoes and creamy, tangy tartar sauce.

instructions.title: YOUR FAVOURITE POTATO ROASTIES
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the halved baby potatoes on a roasting tray. Coat in oil, season, and spread out in a single layer. Roast in the hot oven for 35-40 minutes until crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, shifting halfway.

instructions.title: WHIP UP THE TARTAR SAUCE & WARM THE PEAS
instructions.text: Boil a full kettle. In a bowl, combine the mayo, yoghurt, chopped dill, and diced gherkins. Season to taste and set aside for serving. Submerge the peas in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until plump. Drain on completion and set aside.

instructions.title: BUBBLE THE BEANS
instructions.text: When the potatoes have 10 minutes remaining, fill a pot with boiled water. Add a pinch of salt and place over a high heat. Once boiling, blanch the sliced green beans for 2-3 minutes until cooked al dente. Drain on completion, run under cold water to stop the cooking process, and set aside.

instructions.title: LEMONY CAJUN HAKE
instructions.text: Pat the hake dry with paper towel. Coat in the Cajun Rub and some seasoning (both to taste). Place a large pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the hake skin-side down for 3-4 minutes until crispy. Flip and fry for another 2-3 minutes until the flesh is sealed. Add the grated garlic, a generous squeeze of lemon juice, and a knob of butter (optional). Use this to baste the fish for 1-2 minutes until cooked through and fragrant. Remove from the heat on completion and set aside in the pan until serving.

instructions.title: FRESH GREEN SALAD
instructions.text: Place the shredded green leaves in a bowl with the peas and green beans. Add a squeeze of lemon juice and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss to coat and season to taste.

instructions.title: EASY PEASY, LEMON SQUEEZY!
instructions.text: Plate the golden baby potatoes, Cajun-spiced hake, and green salad alongside one another. Serve with the homemade tartar sauce and any remaining lemon wedges on the side. Well done, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: To cook food 'al dente' means that it should still be firm when bitten. It must be tender, but not soft! This typically refers to pasta, but also applies to other grains, as well as a range of veg. In the case of green beans, they should still have a snap to them once cooked.

recipes.title: Fusion Hot Smoked Trout
recipes.subtitle: with miso mayo & egg noodles
recipes.description: This dish is alive with umami, boasting layers upon layers of amazing flavour! Hot smoked trout tops a stir fry of egg noodles, wilted spinach, and peanuts. Seasoned with soy sauce and vinegar, loaded with a sauté of pickled peppers and corn, and splattered with a creamy miso mayo, this dish has everything you could hope for from a dinner!

ingredients.name: Soy Vinegar
ingredients.prep: (30ml Low Sodium Soy Sauce & 20ml Rice Wine Vinegar)

instructions.title: OODS OF NOODS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 60°C. Boil the kettle. Fill a pot for the noodles with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and place over a medium-high heat. Once boiling rapidly, cook the noodles for 7-8 minutes until al dente. Drain on completion and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: FEELING NUTTY
instructions.text: Place a pan, large enough for the stir fry, over a medium heat. When hot, toast the peanuts for 3-5 minutes until golden, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan and roughly chop.

instructions.title: PREP STEP
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the soy vinegar and 20ml of olive oil until emulsified. Set aside. Place the miso mayo in a small bowl and loosen with water in 5ml increments until drizzling consistency. Set aside for serving.

instructions.title: WARM THE TROUT
instructions.text: Place the hot smoked trout fillets on a greased baking tray and place in the warm oven for 10 minutes until warmed through.

instructions.title: TANGY & UMAMI
instructions.text: Return the pan to a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the corn and fry for 3-4 minutes until charred, shifting occasionally. Add the chopped pickled peppers and fry for 3-4 minutes until starting to brown, shifting occasionally. Add ½ of the chopped peanuts, the emulsified soy vinegar, the cooked noodles, a sweetener of choice, and seasoning. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the sauce has slightly reduced, tossing occasionally. In the final minute, add the rinsed spinach and cook until wilted.

instructions.title: NOODLE MANIA!
instructions.text: Make a bed of saucy noodle stir-fry. Top with the trout and drizzles of the loosened miso mayo. Garnish with the picked coriander and the remaining peanuts. Wowzers!

recipes.chef_tip: To emulsify means to combine two ingredients that do not usually mix together. In cooking, it is usually a fat or oil and a water-based liquid. In this case, it's the soy sauce and olive oil!
