recipes.title: Classic Cheesy Nachos
recipes.subtitle: with ready-made guacamole, fresh chives & a baked chilli relleno
recipes.description: A Nacho Dinner Extravaganza, with all the usual guests: a tangy guacamole, a cluster of corn nachos, strings of melty cheese, a spicy kidney bean and corn chilli, and a sassy, cheese-stuffed jalapeño.

instructions.title: NACHO FILLING
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Dice half of the peeled red onion and set aside. Finely slice the remainder. Place a large pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the sliced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft. Add the Mexican spice blend to taste and fry for another minute. Stir in the cooked chopped tomatoes, drained kidney beans, and 120ml of water. Allow to simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: WHILE THE NACHO SAUCE IS REDUCING...
instructions.text: Stuff your chilli rellenos! Make a horizontal incision along one side of the jalapeños, keeping the stems intact. It should be just deep enough to allow you to remove and discard the seeds. Stuff the deseeded jalapeños with some grated cheese mix and set aside.

instructions.title: COMPLETE THE FILLING
instructions.text: Once the sauce has thickened, stir through the corn and a squeeze of lemon juice. Add some sweetener of choice to taste, season, and remove the pan from the heat.

instructions.title: CHIP CHIP HOORAY!
instructions.text: Spread a layer of nachos over the bottom of a roasting tray. (Use two trays if necessary to keep the layers to the recommended number.) Evenly spoon over half of the nacho sauce and scatter over half of the remaining grated cheese. Repeat this process once more to create one more layer of each, using up the rest of the sauce and cheese. Place the chilli rellenos on top of the nachos and pop the tray in the oven. Bake for 6-8 minutes until the cheese has melted.

instructions.title: SPRUCE IT UP
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the guacamole with three-quarters of the chopped chives. Mix in the diced onion and a squeeze of lemon juice (both to taste) and season.

instructions.title: IT’S GONNA GUAC YOUR WORLD!
instructions.text: For serving, you can either eat the cheesy corn nachos right out of the tray or dish them up on plates. Dollop over the tangy guacamole and sprinkle over the remaining chopped chives. Get stuck in!

recipes.chef_tip: Draining and rinsing tinned beans, lentils, and chickpeas before use drastically reduces the amount of sodium you’re adding to your meal. It also reduces the complex sugar content (which humans can’t digest!) and improves the flavour and texture of the food.
recipes.obscured_details: Chef's Tip text partially obscured by binder ring hole ('flavour [and] texture').

recipes.title: Crispy Gnocchi & Tomato Salad
recipes.subtitle: with baby marrows & a balsamic vinaigrette
recipes.description: Fun Fact: Gnocchi isn’t a type of pasta. Traditional gnocchi is made from potatoes, which makes it a dumpling. Another fact is that this gnocchi recipe is delicious! On a bed of green leaves rests crispy pillows of butternut gnocchi, dotted with rounds of green baby marrow and pops of tangy blistered baby tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Baby Marrow
ingredients.prep: rinsed, trimmed & cut into thick rounds

instructions.title: PILLOWS FOR YOUR PALATE
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place a pot for the gnocchi over a high heat. Fill with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and bring back up to the boil. Once boiling, cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: HEAR THEM POP
instructions.text: Place the pumpkin seeds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until beginning to pop and turning brown. Remove from the pan and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: BLISTERED BALSAMIC TOMATOES
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the halved baby tomatoes for 3-4 minutes until blistered and charred. Remove from the pan and place in a bowl along with the finely diced onion, the balsamic vinegar, ½ of the chopped parsley, a drizzle of olive oil, some sweetener (to taste), and some seasoning. Mix well to combine and set aside.

instructions.title: WHERE DID MY BABY MARROW GO?
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the baby marrow rounds and fry for 3-4 minutes until charred, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan and season. Cover and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: BUTTER THEM UP
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a knob of butter. When starting to foam, fry the cooked gnocchi and the rub in a single layer for 2-4 minutes until browned and crisped.

instructions.title: IT’S AN ITALIAN FEAST!
instructions.text: Make a bed of the rinsed green leaves. Scatter over the charred baby marrow, the crispy gnocchi, and the balsamic tomatoes. Drizzle over any of the remaining balsamic dressing from the tomatoes. Sprinkle over the pumpkin seeds, and garnish with the remaining chopped parsley. Enjoy, Chef!

recipes.obscured_details: Nutritional information partially obscured by binder ring hole (Energy kcal unit and Protein value).

recipes.title: Tasty Tex-Mex Enchiladas
recipes.subtitle: with pickled peppers, corn & black beans
recipes.description: This vegetarian, ready-in-4-steps, Mexican comfort food will rock your socks. Spiced black bean ragù wrapped up inside a flour tortilla, smothered in cheese and baked until crispy and golden. Topped with a charred sweet corn and black bean salsa, and coriander crème fraîche!

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.prep: finely sliced, keeping the white & green parts separate

instructions.title: TEX-MEX RAGÙ
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place a pot over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the sliced white spring onion parts and ½ the drained corn for 3-4 minutes until the spring onions are soft and the corn is starting to char. Add in the grated garlic, the chopped pickled peppers, the Mexican spice blend, the sliced chilli (to taste), and cook for 2-3 minutes, shifting occasionally. On completion, reduce the heat to low and stir through the cooked chopped tomato. Simmer for 8-10 minutes until reduced and thickened, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: SALSA & CRÈME
instructions.text: Place a pan over a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the remaining drained corn for 3-4 minutes until charred, shifting occasionally. On completion, transfer to a bowl. Add in ½ the drained black beans, the green spring onion parts, and season. Toss to combine. In a separate small bowl, mix together the crème fraîche, ½ of the chopped coriander, a splash of water, and some seasoning.

instructions.title: ROLL ‘EM UP
instructions.text: When the ragù has 2-3 minutes remaining, stir through the remaining black beans until heated through. Remove from the heat and season with salt, pepper, sweetener of choice (optional), and lime juice (to taste). Grease a roasting tray or ovenproof dish with a little butter or oil. Spread the ragù evenly over the tortillas and roll each one up into a tube. Place on the tray or dish and top with the grated cheese. Bake in the hot oven for 4-5 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden.

instructions.title: DINE’O CLOCK
instructions.text: Plate up the cheesy enchiladas and sprinkle over the corn and black bean salsa. Dollop over the coriander-crème fraîche and garnish with the remaining coriander. Tuck in!

recipes.chef_tip: Black beans are a great source of fiber, protein and folate. Folate contributes to normal amino acid production and is necessary for normal blood formation.
recipes.obscured_details: The allergen 'Sulphites' is partially obscured by the binder ring hole.

recipes.title: Sage & Roast Butternut Gnocchi
recipes.subtitle: with burnt butter, crème fraîche & toasted pine nuts
recipes.description: Sage burnt butter and gnocchi: an all-time favourite! These mini dumplings are browned and crisped but retain their gloriously gooey centre. Tossed with Italian-style hard cheese and served atop roast butternut and fresh rocket. Mouthwateringly moreish!

instructions.title: ROAST THE BUTTERNUT
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the butternut pieces on a roasting tray. Coat in oil, season, and spread out in a single layer. Roast in the hot oven for 35-40 minutes until cooked through and crisping up, shifting halfway.

instructions.title: TOAST THE NUTS & PREP THE CHEESE
instructions.text: Place the pine nuts in a large pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden brown, shifting occasionally. Keep a close eye on them; they burn easily! Remove from the pan on completion. Using a vegetable peeler, shave half of the hard cheese into ribbons and set aside for garnish. Grate the remainder and set aside for the burnt butter.

instructions.title: GNOCCHI ON THE GO!
instructions.text: When the butternut reaches the halfway mark, boil the kettle. Place a pot over a high heat, fill with boiling water, and add a pinch of salt. Once boiling rapidly, cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain on completion.

instructions.title: CRISPY GNOCCHI & SAGE BURNT BUTTER
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a knob of butter. When starting to foam, fry the gnocchi in a single layer for 2-4 minutes until browned and crisped. Do this step in batches for the crispiest results, adding more butter between batches. Remove from the pan on completion. Return the pan to the heat with 160g of butter. Bring to a simmer and stir for 3-4 minutes until foaming and light brown. Add the sage leaves and fry for 2-3 minutes until crispy. On completion, return the gnocchi to the pan along with the grated hard cheese. Toss to coat, season to taste, and remove from the heat.

instructions.title: SOME FRESHNESS
instructions.text: Place the rinsed rocket in a bowl with a drizzle of the cab sauv vinegar. Toss to coat and season to taste.

instructions.title: ORA DI CENA! DINNERTIME!
instructions.text: Make a bed of dressed rocket and cover in the gorgeous roast butternut. Top with the burnt butter and sage gnocchi and dollop over the crème fraîche. Garnish with the hard cheese shavings and a scattering of pine nuts. Buon appetito, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: For the best results, boil the gnocchi in batches to prevent crowding the pot and overcooking.

recipes.title: Fully Loaded Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.subtitle: with chilli cheese, cremè fraîche & a spinach and charred corn salad
recipes.description: Would you believe, we put chilli cheese on BBQ basted sweet potato fries? Well, we did, and not only that, we added a charred corn and spinach salad! Oh, and sprinkles of coriander and crispy onions? Yes indeed! Dollops of cremè fraîche? You betcha!

instructions.title: LET'S GO!
instructions.text: Fill a pot, large enough for the sweet potato fries, with salted water. Place over high heat and bring to a boil. Once boiling, add the fries and boil for 5-6 minutes until slightly softened. On completion, drain the fries on paper towel.

instructions.title: CHAR
instructions.text: Place a pan over high heat with a drizzle of oil. Once hot, add the corn and fry for 3-5 minutes until slightly charred, shifting constantly. Place in a salad bowl.

instructions.title: BEAN CHILLI
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to the grill setting or the highest temperature. Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. Fry the diced onion and for 4-5 minutes until softened, add the chopped chilli and fry for about a minute until fragrant. Stir through the drained beans, cooked chopped tomato, sweetener of choice, 150ml of water and leave to simmer for 8-9 minutes until reduced and thickened. In the final minute, stir through 1/2 of the rinsed spinach and some seasoning.

instructions.title: GOLDEN FRIES
instructions.text: Return the pot to a medium-high heat and fill with enough oil to deep fry the fries. Place the corn flour in a bowl with some seasoning and gently toss through the fries until fully coated. Once the oil is hot, deep fry the fries for about 3-5 minutes until crispy and golden. Remove from the oil and drain on paper towel. On completion, place the sweet potato fries in a bowl, toss until coated with BBQ rub and season.

instructions.title: CHEESY CHILLI
instructions.text: Place the bean chilli in an ovenproof dish and sprinkle over the grated cheese. Place in the oven and leave for 3-5 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden. In a bowl toss together the remaining spinach, charred corn with a drizzle of oil and seasoning.

instructions.title: OMG!
instructions.text: Cover a plate in the crispy sweet potato fries. Top with the cheesy chilli and side with the charred corn salad. Sprinkle over the chopped coriander, crispy onions, and dollop with some cremè fraîche. The wait is over!

recipes.chef_tip: If you have an airfryer, use it to fry your fries instead of deep frying them!

recipes.title: Delheim's Creamy Mushroom Gnocchi
recipes.subtitle: with crispy sage butter, fresh cream & a side salad
recipes.description: Tender on the inside and crisp on the outside, this potato gnocchi is steeped in a decadently creamy mushroom and hard cheese sauce, topped with buttery sage, and served with a leafy tomato side salad. A dinner to remember!

ingredients.name: Salad Dressing
ingredients.prep: (30ml Willow Creek Cabernet Sauvignon Vinegar & 10ml Honey)

instructions.title: GET GOING
instructions.text: Place the seeds in a large pan over a medium heat. Toast for 2-4 minutes until lightly browned, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool. In a salad bowl, whisk together the dressing and 20ml of olive oil until well combined. Toss through the quartered baby tomatoes, season to taste, and set aside.

instructions.title: CRISPY SAGE BUTTER
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and a generous knob of butter. Once foaming, fry the sage leaves for about 1 minute per side until crispy. (Use tongs if you have them!) Remove from the pan and set aside to drain on paper towel. Pour the sage butter into a bowl and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: CARAMELISE THE MUSHIES
instructions.text: Return the pan to the heat with another drizzle of oil if necessary. Wipe the mushrooms clean and roughly slice. When the pan is hot, fry for 3-5 minutes until golden, shifting as they colour. You may need to do this step in batches. Remove from the pan, season, and set aside.

instructions.title: THINGS ARE HEATING UP!
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place a pot over a high heat, fill with boiling water, and add a pinch of salt. Once bubbling, cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain on completion, reserving 1 cup of the water. Return the pan to a medium-high heat with another drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the gnocchi in a single layer for 2-4 minutes until crisp and golden, shifting as they colour. Remove from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: CREAMY SAUCE
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with another drizzle of oil if necessary. When hot, sauté the diced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft. Add in the grated garlic and sauté for a minute until fragrant. Lower the heat and stir in the cream, the cheese, 60ml of milk, and seasoning. Simmer for 2-3 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally. Mix in the gnocchi and mushrooms, and cook for 2-3 minutes until coated and reheated. If the sauce is too thick, loosen with the reserved gnocchi water. Remove from the heat on completion. Toss the rinsed green leaves through the bowl of tomatoes.

instructions.title: YOU'RE IN FOR A TREAT!
instructions.text: Dish up the decadent gnocchi, pour over the sage butter to taste, and top with the sage leaves. Side with the salad and sprinkle it all with the sunflower seeds. Scrumptious!

recipes.chef_tip: For the best results, boil the gnocchi in batches to prevent crowding the pot and overcooking.

recipes.title: Zippy Black Bean Nachos
recipes.subtitle: with melted cheddar, crème fraîche & spicy tomato salsa
recipes.description: Planning a nacho night? We've got it covered! Smothered in black bean chilli, oozing with cheddar cheese, and complemented by coriander-infused crème fraîche, these nachos will have you licking your plate...

instructions.title: GET THE CHILLI GOING
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C on the grill setting. Place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the diced onion for 2-3 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the Mexican spice blend to taste and fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Pour in the cooked chopped tomatoes and simmer for 10-12 minutes until slightly thickened, stirring regularly. If it starts to become too thick, simply add a splash of water.

instructions.title: SALSALICIOUS
instructions.text: Place the quartered baby tomatoes, the chopped jalapeños, and half of the chopped coriander in a bowl. Add a drizzle of olive oil and toss to combine. Season and set aside for serving. In a second bowl, combine the crème fraîche with the remaining coriander and loosen with a small splash of milk or water. Season to taste and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: ADD THOSE BEANS & CORN
instructions.text: Once the sauce has reduced, stir through the drained black beans and corn. Cook for a further 3-4 minutes until heated through, stirring constantly. Season to taste and remove from the heat on completion.

instructions.title: SAY CHEEEESE!
instructions.text: Spread out the nachos on a large roasting tray. Pour over the bean chilli and evenly sprinkle with the grated cheese. Bake in the hot oven for 5-6 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden. Ovens vary, so keep a close eye on the cheese to make sure it doesn't burn!

instructions.title: CHEESY NACHO TREAT
instructions.text: Plate up some nachos and cheesy bean chilli. Top with the spicy, tangy salsa and dollop over the coriander crème fraîche. Time to get stuck in!

recipes.chef_tip: If you'd prefer to eat the nachos as dippers, simply bake the black bean chilli and cheese without them, and serve them on the side for scooping it all up!

recipes.title: Cheesy Gnocchi Napoletana
recipes.subtitle: with mozzarella, fresh basil & a crisp side salad
recipes.description: This marriage of crispy, butter-fried sweet potato gnocchi and a two-cheese tomato sauce will make you weep with joy! With added flavour from crunchy chickpeas, garlic, and Italian herbs and added freshness from a leafy salad with radish and tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Grated Cheese Mix
ingredients.prep: (120g Grated Italian Style Cheese & 100g Grated Mozzarella)

instructions.title: GET THOSE CHICKPEAS POPPIN'
instructions.text: Place a pot for the gnocchi over a high heat. Fill with water, add a pinch of salt, and leave to come to the boil for step 2. Place a large pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, toast the drained chickpeas for 12-13 minutes until crispy. For the best results, only shift occasionally. If they start to pop out, use a lid to rein them in. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside.

instructions.title: SWEET POTATO TREATS
instructions.text: Once the water is boiling rapidly, use 150ml to dilute the stock and set aside. Pop the gnocchi into the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float. Drain on completion, place in a bowl, and toss through some oil to prevent sticking. Wipe down the pot for step 3.

instructions.title: TIME TO GET SAUCY!
instructions.text: Once the chickpeas are crispy, wipe down the pot and return to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil or knob of butter. When heated slightly, fry the grated garlic and Italian Rub for a minute until fragrant, shifting constantly. Stir in the cooked chopped tomatoes and the diluted stock. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally. Add three-quarters of the halved baby tomatoes and simmer for a further 2-3 minutes until softened, breaking them up as they cook. On completion, season to taste with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice. Keep warm over a low heat while you fry the gnocchi.

instructions.title: NUGGETS OF GOLDEN GNOCCHI
instructions.text: Wipe down the pan and return it to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and a knob of butter. Once foaming, brown the gnocchi for 3-5 minutes until crisped. For the best results, fry in a single layer in batches if necessary, adding more butter in between batches. Remove from the heat on completion and add to the pot of sauce. Mix in three-quarters of the grated cheese until melted and evenly distributed. Stir through the crispy chickpeas and remove from the heat.

instructions.title: IT'S A TOSS UP
instructions.text: Toss together the shredded green leaves, the sliced radish, and the remaining halved baby tomatoes. Add a drizzle of olive oil, season, and toss again to coat.

instructions.title: CHEESY COMFORT FOOD
instructions.text: Dish up hearty spoonfuls of cheesy tomato gnocchi and plate the crisp salad on the side. Finish off with sprinkles of the remaining grated cheese and the fresh, sliced basil. Bellissimo, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: For the best results, boil the gnocchi in batches to prevent crowding the pot and overcooking.

recipes.title: Knife & Fork Nachos
recipes.subtitle: with spiced sweet potato, cottage cheese & crispy onions
recipes.description: These ‘nachos’ are made of golden roast sweet potato, loaded with flakey kale, piles of beans and corn, melty mozzarella, and chive-y cream cheese. With a crunch of crackly onions and a bite from jalapeño to boot!

instructions.title: NA-CHO ORDINARY NACHOS!
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread out the sweet potato spheres on a roasting tray – use two trays if necessary. Coat in oil, ½ of the Spanish Rub, and a little seasoning to taste. Roast in the hot oven for 35-40 minutes until cooked through and crisping up.

instructions.title: A LITTLE PREP
instructions.text: Place the shredded kale in a bowl with a drizzle of oil and some seasoning. Using your hands, massage until softened and coated. Set aside for step 3. Place the cottage cheese in a small bowl with ¾ of the chopped chives. Combine with the lime zest and a squeeze of lime juice, both to taste. Season and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: CRISPY KALE
instructions.text: When the sweet potato reaches the halfway mark, remove the tray from the oven and spread the spheres further out over the base and up the sides of the dish. Scatter over the kale and return to the oven for 8-10 minutes until crispy.

instructions.title: LOOKING GOOD...
instructions.text: When the kale is crispy, remove the tray from the oven and scatter over the drained kidney beans and corn. Evenly sprinkle with the remaining Spanish Rub and the mozzarella. Return to the oven and bake for 7-10 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden.

instructions.title: DINE LIKE A KING
instructions.text: Plate up the loaded sweet potato "nachos" and cover in dollops of chive-infused cottage cheese. Finish off with scatterings of crispy onions, chopped jalapeños, and remaining chives. Serve with a lime wedge on the side. Time to feast, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: Draining and rinsing tinned beans, lentils, and chickpeas reduces the amount of sodium added to your meal. It also reduces the complex sugar content and improves flavour and texture of food.
recipes.obscured_details: Allergen 'Sulphites' is partially obscured by the binder ring hole ('Su...es').

recipes.title: Bistro Sixteen82 Bacon Ragù Gnocchi
recipes.subtitle: with hard cheese, spinach & a melted Emmental and cream swirl
recipes.description: Don't miss out on this extraordinary meal, designed by the Head Chef of Steenberg's two restaurants. Tantalising tomato-based ragù – thick, silky, and packed with bacon – surrounds crisp butternut gnocchi. Rippled with warm Emmental cream and popping with seeds.

instructions.title: OPENING ACT
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place the pumpkin seeds in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until browned, shifting occasionally. Set aside to cool. Fill a pot with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and place over a high heat. Once bubbling, cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until floating and heated through. Drain, reserving a cup of the water. Toss some oil through the gnocchi and set aside.

instructions.title: NEXT UP
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onion for 6-8 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally. Add the chopped carrot and a splash of water. Simmer for 5-6 minutes until the carrot is al dente and the water has been absorbed. In the final minute, add the grated garlic and sauté until fragrant. Mix in the cooked chopped tomato until well combined and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: MEANWHILE...
instructions.text: Place a second large pan over a medium heat. When hot, fry the bacon for 2 minutes per side until cooked but not too crispy. Set aside to drain on paper towel. Wipe down the pan and return it to a medium heat with a knob of butter and a small drizzle of oil. Once foaming, fry the gnocchi in a single layer for 4-5 minutes until crispy, shifting as they colour. Do this step in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan. Remove the pan from the heat. Roughly chop the bacon.

instructions.title: FINALE!
instructions.text: Once the sauce has simmered, lower the heat and stir in the rinsed spinach and ¾ of the bacon. If the sauce is too thick, gradually mix in the reserved gnocchi water until the desired consistency. Simmer for 3-4 minutes until the spinach has wilted. On completion, stir through the fried gnocchi. Season to taste with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice, and remove from the heat.

instructions.title: SILKY SWIRL
instructions.text: Place the cream in a small pot over a medium heat. Once bubbling, cook for 4-5 minutes until slightly thickened and reduced, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat, whisk in the grated Emmental cheese until melted, and season.

instructions.title: THE TASTE OF WARM SUNSET
instructions.text: Help yourself to bacon ragù gnocchi and a swirl of Emmental cream. Sprinkle over the hard cheese and remaining bacon. Garnish with the seeds and chopped parsley. Magnificent!

recipes.chef_tip: Make sure you use a large enough pot to boil the gnocchi so that they don't end up sticking together from overcrowding. You can boil them in batches if necessary.
recipes.obscured_details: Ring binder punch hole clips the end of allergen 'Wheat' ('Whea').

recipes.title: Tryn's Truffle Mushroom Tagliatelle
recipes.subtitle: with charred broccoli, spinach & an artichoke and cream velouté
recipes.description: This creamy mushroom pasta’s gonna be your new go-to cosy comfort food! Designed by the Head Chef of Steenberg’s restaurant Tryn, it features fresher-than-fresh tagliatelle, illuminated by broccoli, truffle zest, and a caramelised artichoke and cream sauce. Hard to beat!

ingredients.name: Italian-style Hard Cheese
ingredients.prep: ½ grated & ½ peeled into ribbons

instructions.title: GOLDEN MUSHIES
instructions.text: Place a nonstick pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and a knob of butter (optional). When hot, fry the sliced mushrooms for 4-5 minutes until soft and golden, shifting as they colour. On completion, transfer to a bowl and season. Cover to keep warm and set aside.

instructions.title: BUBBLE THE BROC
instructions.text: Wipe down the pan and return it to a medium-high heat with another drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the broccoli florets for 4-5 minutes until lightly charred. Add a splash of water, cover with a lid, and simmer for 1-2 minutes until cooked al dente. Remove from the pan and add to the bowl of mushrooms.

instructions.title: CREAMY ARTICHOKE SAUCE
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with another drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the artichoke hearts for 4-5 minutes until lightly charred. Deglaze the pan with a splash of water, and mix in the cream and grated hard cheese. Allow to simmer for 3-4 minutes until slightly reduced, stirring occasionally. On completion, transfer to a blender. Blend until smooth and set aside.

instructions.title: FRESHER THAN FRESH!
instructions.text: Place a pot of salted water over a high heat and leave to come to the boil. Toss ½ of the rinsed spinach with a squeeze of lemon juice, a pinch of zest, and some seasoning. Set aside for serving. Once the water is bubbling rapidly, cook the pasta for 2-3 minutes until al dente. Drain on completion, reserving a cup of the water. Toss some oil through the pasta to prevent sticking and return to the pot. Cover with a lid and set aside to keep warm.

instructions.title: IT'S THE LAST STRETCH
instructions.text: Return the pan to a low heat. Add in the mushrooms and broccoli, the artichoke sauce, and the remaining spinach. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the spinach is wilted, stirring occasionally. If the sauce is too thick, gradually loosen with the reserved pasta water. Season to taste with lemon juice, zest, salt, and pepper. Remove from the heat on completion. Pour ½ into the pot of pasta and toss to coat.

instructions.title: BRAVO!
instructions.text: Dish up a bowl of creamy pasta and spoon over the remaining artichoke sauce. Sprinkle with the chopped parsley and truffle zest. Serve the salad on the side, and scatter the hard cheese ribbons over the lot. Hop to it, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: Deglazing is a technique for lifting food residue from the base of a pan by adding in liquid and using a utensil to stir and scrape. This mixture can be used to add flavour to sauces and gravies.

recipes.title: NONNA'S GNOCCHI BAKE
recipes.subtitle: with sweet potato gnocchi, fresh oregano & capers
recipes.description: Flavourful Italian ingredients the whole family will savour. Drench the gnocchi in a tomato, caper, and oregano sauce, smother in cheese, bake to golden perfection, and serve with a spritely salad. A feast the way your nonna would make it.

instructions.title: PERFECT PODS OF GNOCCHI
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Boil the kettle. Place a pot for the gnocchi over a high heat. Fill with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and bring back up to the boil. Once boiling rapidly, cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain on completion, place in a bowl, and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: NONNA'S FAMOUS SAUCE
instructions.text: Rinse the pot if necessary and return to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onion for 5-6 minutes until soft and translucent, shifting regularly. Add the grated garlic, the sliced chilli (to taste), and three-quarters of the chopped oregano. Sauté for 30-60 seconds until fragrant. Stir through the reserved caper brine, the cooked chopped tomatoes, and half of the chopped capers. Allow to simmer for 7-10 minutes until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally. On completion, remove the pot from the heat and season with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice to taste.

instructions.title: BAKE THE CHEESY GNOCCHI
instructions.text: Add the cooked gnocchi to the pot of sauce and gently stir to coat. Transfer to an ovenproof dish and spread out in an even layer. Evenly sprinkle over the grated cheese mix and bake in the hot oven for 15-17 minutes until the cheese melts and becomes golden.

instructions.title: SPRITELY, FRESH SALAD
instructions.text: Just before serving, toss the rinsed green leaves with the remaining capers, a drizzle of cab sauv vinegar, and some seasoning.

instructions.title: A COMFORTING DINNER – NONNA STYLE!
instructions.text: Dish up a helping of cheesy gnocchi bake and side with the dressed green salad. Garnish with the remaining chopped oregano and sprinkle over any remaining fresh chilli if you'd like. Buon appetito!

recipes.chef_tip: For the best results, boil the gnocchi in batches to prevent crowding the pot and overcooking.

recipes.title: Spicy Mexican Tomato Pasta
recipes.subtitle: with corn & cashew nut cream cheese
recipes.description: Think nachos with a pasta twist... are you imagining it? Well no need because it's right here! Tasty homemade tomato sauce and corn is mixed through tender fusilli pasta before being topped with dollops of cashew nut cream cheese, sprinklings of crispy onion, and a dash of spicy jalapeño and lime. Wow, wow and wow!

instructions.title: WHAT'S ALL THE FUSILLI ABOUT?
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Fill a pot with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and place over a high heat. Once bubbling rapidly, add a drizzle of oil and cook the pasta for 13-15 minutes until al dente. Keep stirring for the first 3 minutes to prevent sticking, then stir sporadically during the remaining cooking time. Drain on completion, reserving a cup of pasta water, and return to the pot. Toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: MEXI SAUCE
instructions.text: Place a deep pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft and translucent, shifting occasionally. Add the corn and fry for 4-5 minutes until charred, shifting occasionally. Add the spice blend and ½ the chilli flakes (to taste) and fry for 1 minute until fragrant, shifting constantly. Pour in the tomato passata and leave to simmer for 4-5 minutes, until slightly reduced. On completion, season with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice (to taste).

instructions.title: TOSS IT UP
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the cream cheese with the lime zest and seasoning. Set aside. Add the cooked pasta to the pan with the sauce. Toss until fully coated and loosen with the reserved pasta water, if necessary.

instructions.title: MEXICAN PASTA FIESTA!
instructions.text: Dish up the hearty Mexican pasta. Top with the chopped jalapeños (to taste), the crispy onions, the chopped coriander, and the remaining chilli flakes (to taste). Dollop on the zesty cashew cream cheese and serve with a lime wedge. Dig in, Chef!

recipes.title: Crispy Bacon & Pea Gnocchi
recipes.subtitle: with garlic, fresh basil & grated Italian-style hard cheese
recipes.description: Get ready to knock a gnocchi recipe out of the park! You'll be cooking an impressive dish today but won't have to put in hours behind the stove to achieve the delectable tastes of pillowy butternut gnocchi, crispy bacon, and pops of peas, all covered in a creamy garlic, wine & tomato sauce.

instructions.title: GO, GO GNOCCHI!
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place a pot for the gnocchi over a high heat. Fill with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and bring back up to the boil. Once boiling, add the gnocchi and cook for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain, reserving a cup of the gnocchi water, and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: BRING ON THE BACON
instructions.text: Place a pan over medium-high heat. When hot, add the bacon slices and fry for 1-2 minutes per side until browned and crispy. Drain on paper towel and roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.

instructions.title: IT'S ALL ABOUT THE SAUCE
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil (if necessary). When hot, add the grated garlic, the tomato paste, and the wine. Cook for 1-2 minutes or until almost all evaporated. Add 40g of butter and the flour. Fry for 1-2 minutes, shifting constantly. Remove from the heat and gradually stir in the milk, making sure there are no lumps. Loosen the sauce with the reserved gnocchi water until the desired consistency.

instructions.title: FINAL TOUCHES & FLAVOURS
instructions.text: Return the pan with the sauce to a medium heat and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, add the paprika, the peas, ½ the grated cheese, a squeeze of lemon juice (to taste), a sweetener (to taste), and seasoning. Mix until combined and remove from the heat. Stir through the cooked gnocchi, ½ the chopped bacon, and ½ the sliced basil.

instructions.title: DISH UP DINNER
instructions.text: Plate up the creamy pea & bacon gnocchi and sprinkle over the remaining cheese, bacon, and basil. Garnish with lemon zest (to taste) and finish off with a crack of black pepper. Side with any remaining lemon wedges. Cheers, Chef!

recipes.title: Double Creamed Mediterranean Pasta
recipes.subtitle: with cashew cream cheese, sun-dried tomatoes & gluten-free fettuccine
recipes.description: This dreamboat is vegan, gluten-conscious, and boasts two sources of creaminess: nutritional yeast and cashew cream cheese thicken a silky smooth roast butternut pasta sauce, scattered with sun-dried tomatoes and a zesty quinoa flake crumb.

ingredients.name: Gluten-free Crumb
ingredients.prep: 15ml BIO XXI Quinoa Flakes & 15ml Almond Flour

instructions.title: FRESH HERBS & BUTTERNUT
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the butternut pieces and rinsed rosemary on a roasting tray. Coat in oil, season, and spread out evenly. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and starting to crisp, shifting halfway. Remove from the oven on completion.

instructions.title: ZESTY QUINOA FLAKES
instructions.text: Place a nonstick pan over a medium heat — use a deep pan if you have one! When hot, toast the gluten-free crumb for 2-3 minutes until light gold, shifting continuously. On completion, toss through ¾ of the chopped parsley, the lemon zest to taste, and some seasoning. Remove from the pan and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: GET THE BOIL ROLLING
instructions.text: When the butternut has 10 minutes remaining, boil a full kettle. Fill a pot with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and place over a high heat. Once bubbling rapidly, add a drizzle of oil and cook the pasta for 13-15 minutes until al dente. Keep stirring for the first 3 minutes to prevent sticking, then stir sporadically during the remaining cooking time.

instructions.title: MAKE YOUR CREAMY SAUCE
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the diced onion for 4-5 minutes until soft. Add the grated garlic and fry for another minute, shifting continuously. Remove the pan from the heat, and stir through the nutritional yeast and ¾ of the cashew cream cheese. Pour into a blender and add in the cooked butternut, discarding the rosemary stalks. Blend until smooth, gradually adding 150ml of boiled water until pourable but still thick. (You might not need to add all of the water.) Return to the pan, cover to keep warm, and set aside.

instructions.title: LEVEL UP
instructions.text: When the pasta is cooked, drain and return to the pot. Toss through some oil to further prevent sticking. Add to the pan of sauce and toss to coat. Season to taste with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

instructions.title: YUMMM
instructions.text: Bowl up a heap of indulgent butternut pasta. Scatter over the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, zesty quinoa flakes, and remaining parsley. Finish off with dollops of the remaining cashew cream cheese and a lemon wedge. Bravo, Chef!

recipes.obscured_details: Protein value in nutritional information is obscured by the binder ring hole punch.

recipes.title: Saucy Bacon Gnocchi
recipes.subtitle: with spinach & pumpkin seeds
recipes.description: Don't miss out on this extraordinary meal! Tantalising tomato-based ragù — thick, silky, and packed with bacon — surrounds crisp butternut gnocchi. Sprinkled with Italian-style cheese and popping with seeds.

instructions.title: OPENING ACT
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place the pumpkin seeds in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until browned, shifting occasionally. Set aside to cool. Fill a pot with boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and place over a high heat. Once bubbling, cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until floating and heated through. Drain, reserving a cup of the water. Toss some oil through the gnocchi and set aside.

instructions.title: NEXT UP
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onion for 6-8 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally. Add the chopped carrot and a splash of water. Simmer for 5-6 minutes until the carrot is al dente and the water has been absorbed. In the final minute, add the grated garlic and sauté until fragrant. Mix in the cooked chopped tomato and 300ml of water. Bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: MEANWHILE...
instructions.text: Place a second large pan over a medium heat. When hot, fry the bacon for 2 minutes per side until cooked but not too crispy. Set aside to drain on paper towel. Wipe down the pan and return it to a medium heat with a knob of butter and a small drizzle of oil. Once foaming, fry the gnocchi in a single layer for 4-5 minutes until crispy, shifting as they colour. Do this step in batches to avoid overcrowding the pan. Remove the pan from the heat. Roughly chop the bacon.

instructions.title: FINALE!
instructions.text: Once the sauce has simmered, remove from the heat. Stir in the rinsed spinach, ¾ of the bacon and the fried gnocchi. If the sauce is too thick, gradually mix in the reserved gnocchi water until the desired consistency. Season to taste with salt, pepper, and a sweetener of choice, and remove from the heat.

instructions.title: THE TASTE OF A WARM SUNSET
instructions.text: Help yourself to bacon ragù gnocchi. Sprinkle over the grated cheese and the remaining bacon. Garnish with the seeds and chopped parsley. Magnificent!

recipes.chef_tip: Make sure you use a large enough pot to boil the gnocchi, so that they don't end up sticking together from overcrowding. You can boil them in batches if necessary.

recipes.title: Dreamy Halloumi & Artichokes
recipes.subtitle: with crispy cannellini beans, pumpkin seeds & a lemon-honey dressing
recipes.description: A Mediterranean fantasy! Grilled halloumi tops tender artichoke hearts, charred baby tomatoes, mixed green leaves, and cannellini beans — all infused with herbs, honey, and lemon. Warming, invigorating, and quick — who could refuse this stunner?

instructions.title: SWEET 'N SOUR SALAD
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place the honey in a salad bowl with ¾ of the chopped parsley and a drizzle of oil. Whisk together with some lemon juice to taste — we recommend using lots of lemon for this dressing! Add in the halved artichokes and ½ of the halved baby tomatoes. Season and toss to coat. Submerge the edamame beans in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until plump and heated through. Drain on completion and add to the salad bowl. Set aside to marinate.

instructions.title: POP DEM SEEDS!
instructions.text: Place the pumpkin seeds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until they begin to pop and turn brown. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: A PAN OF FRAGRANT DELIGHT
instructions.text: Return the pan to a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the drained cannellini beans for 3-4 minutes, shifting occasionally. Stir through the Italian Rub and the remaining tomatoes. Fry for 3-4 minutes until the beans are crispy and the tomatoes are lightly charred. Remove from the pan, cover to keep warm, and set aside.

instructions.title: CRISPY & GOLDEN
instructions.text: Wipe down the pan and return it to a medium heat with another drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the halloumi slabs for 2-3 minutes per side until crispy. Remove from the pan on completion and allow to drain on some paper towel.

instructions.title: PULL IT TOGETHER
instructions.text: Add the warm veggies and the rinsed green leaves to the salad bowl, and toss until evenly distributed. Roughly chop the halloumi into bite-sized chunks and squeeze over any remaining lemon juice to taste.

instructions.title: DINNER IS READY
instructions.text: Dish up the loaded salad and scatter over the golden halloumi. Garnish with the toasted pumpkin seeds and the remaining parsley. Oh what a salad night!

recipes.title: Taphuis Umami Mushroom Gnocchi
recipes.subtitle: with zesty crème fraîche sauce & an umami marmite swirl
recipes.description: Taphuis' head chef brings you a flavour explosion you won't forget! This crisped gnocchi is awash with creamy sauce that's bursting with umami from soy and marmite (for some local charm!) and punctuated by the crunch of almonds and the tang of pickled peppers.

instructions.title: TOASTY ALMONDS
instructions.text: Place the almonds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden brown, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside. Roughly chop when cool enough to handle.

instructions.title: SOFT POCKETS OF DELIGHT
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place a pot for the gnocchi over a high heat. Fill with boiling water and add a pinch of salt. Once bubbling rapidly, cook the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain on completion, setting aside 125ml of the pasta water for step 3. Pat the gnocchi dry with paper towel (this helps to prevent sticking). Return it to the pot and toss through some oil.

instructions.title: TOSS THE SALAD & FRY THE GNOCCHI
instructions.text: Place the rinsed green leaves in a bowl with ½ of the chopped almonds and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss together with some lemon juice and zest to taste. Season and set aside for serving. Return the pan to a medium-high heat with a small drizzle of oil and a knob of butter. When hot, fry the gnocchi in a single layer for 2-4 minutes until crisp, shifting as they colour. Remove from the pan on completion, cover to keep warm, and set aside.

instructions.title: CREAMY & UMAMI
instructions.text: Return the pan to a high heat with another drizzle of oil and knob of butter. When hot, fry the quartered mushrooms for 3-5 minutes until soft and golden, shifting as they colour. You may need to do this step in batches, adding more oil and butter between batches. On completion, return the mushrooms to the pan. Pour in the pasta water to deglaze the pan. Lower the heat and stir through the crème fraîche until combined. Allow to simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: FINISH UP
instructions.text: When the mushroom sauce has 1 minute remaining, mix in the umami sauce to taste and ½ of the grated cheese. Remove from the heat and stir through the gnocchi until coated. If the sauce is too thick, loosen with a small splash of water. Season to taste.

instructions.title: WHAT A FEAST!
instructions.text: Dish up spoonfuls of creamy mushroom gnocchi, and scatter over the chopped pickled peppers and chopped chives. Sprinkle with the remaining grated cheese, almonds, and zest. Serve the salad on the side and finish it all off with a squeeze of lemon. Yum!

recipes.chef_tip: Deglazing is a cooking technique for lifting browned food residue from the base of a pan by adding in liquid and stirring it into the residue using a cooking utensil. This mixture is then used to add flavour sauces, soups, and gravies.
recipes.obscured_details: Minor clipping from binder ring hole punch on Chef's Tip ('add') and Allergens ('Sesame').

recipes.title: Moreish Coffee-Spiced Halloumi
recipes.subtitle: with brown basmati, charred pineapple & Mexican salsa
recipes.description: Awaken your taste buds with these perfectly spiced melty halloumi slabs. Brilliantly charred sweet pineapple and fresh Mexican-style tomato salsa can only make way for a taste sensation — yum!

ingredients.name: Rice & Lentils
ingredients.prep: 150ml Brown Basmati Rice & 50ml Green Puy Lentils

instructions.title: DREAM DUO
instructions.text: Rinse the rice & lentils and place in a pot over a medium-high heat. Submerge in 500ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. On completion, drain if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: MEXICAN-STYLE WARM SALSA
instructions.text: Place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the diced onions and drained kidney beans for 3-4. On completion, the onion should be slightly soft and the kidney beans warmed through. Place in a salad bowl with the halved baby tomatoes, jalapeños, lemon zest, ⅔ chopped coriander, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss to combine and season to taste.

instructions.title: CHAR YOUR RINGS
instructions.text: Drain the pineapple rings. Return the pan to a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the pineapple rings for 1-2 minutes per side until charred.

instructions.title: EAT YOUR GREENS
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the spinach and sauté for 2-4 minutes until softened. Remove on completion and season to taste with salt, pepper, and some lemon juice.

instructions.title: HEAVENLY HALLOUMI
instructions.text: Coat the halloumi slices with the coffee rub and a drizzle of oil. Return the pan to a medium heat. When hot, fry the halloumi for 1-2 minutes per side until crispy and golden. Remove and drain on some paper towel. Roughly slice into bite-size pieces.

instructions.title: NOURISHING MEAL!
instructions.text: Make a bed of rice and lentils. Top with the sautéed spinach, salsa, spiced halloumi, and charred pineapple. Garnish with the remaining coriander leaves and lemon wedges. Enjoy, Chef!

recipes.title: Haute Cabrière Ravioli
recipes.subtitle: with spinach & ricotta, pomodoro sauce & bocconcini
recipes.description: Pomodoro means "tomato" in Italian. Here, piquante peppers, garlic, and a rainbow medley of baby tomatoes meld together with flavoursome flair to smother mouthwatering morsels of spinach and ricotta ravioli, topped off with balls of soft Italian cheese, fresh basil and a crunch of pumpkin seeds. Ah, si piccola!

instructions.title: SEEDS
instructions.text: Boil the kettle for step 3. Place a pot on medium heat. When hot, toast the pumpkin seeds for 3-5 minutes until they begin to pop and colour. Remove on completion and set aside for serving

instructions.title: SAUCE
instructions.text: Return the pot to a medium-low heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add in the grated garlic, baby tomatoes, and chopped piquanté peppers. Give a stir and pop on a lid. Cook for 7-8 minutes until the tomatoes are soft, breaking them up as they cook. If the sauce becomes too dry, add in a drizzle of oil or a knob of butter. On completion, season and set aside. Wipe down the pot and set aside for step 4.

instructions.title: BOIL
instructions.text: Place a pot, with generously salted boiling water, over a medium-high heat. Once boiling rapidly, cook the ravioli for 3-4 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain on completion and toss with oil.

instructions.title: CRISP
instructions.text: Return the pot used for the sauce to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and a knob of butter. Once foaming, fry the ravioli in a single layer for 4-5 minutes until crispy and golden, tossing occasionally. Do this step in batches if necessary. On completion, return all of the ravioli to the pot.

instructions.title: AND!
instructions.text: Keeping the pot on the heat, add in the pomodoro sauce. Cook for 3-4 minutes until heated through, gently tossing to coat the ravioli. Remove from the heat and stir through ½ of the shredded basil, ½ of the bocconcini halves and seasoning to taste. Toss a drizzle of oil through the rinsed green leaves.

instructions.title: GO!
instructions.text: Plate up the ravioli al pomodoro. Scatter over the remaining basil, toasted pumpkin seeds, and remaining bocconcini. Serve the dressed leaves on the side with drizzles of balsamic glaze. Buon appetito!

recipes.chef_tip: Boil the ravioli in batches to prevent crowding the pot and overcooking.

recipes.title: Crispy Halloumi & Pesto Jumble
recipes.subtitle: with quinoa, charred baby marrow & a Dijon dressing
recipes.description: The yellow gold of fried halloumi, the hillside green of baby marrow, and the fiery rouge of pickled tomatoes and red pesto. This dazzling colour palette blends with Dijon-dressed quinoa for a fresh but substantial finish.

ingredients.name: Dijon Dressing
ingredients.prep: 30ml White Wine Vinegar, 15ml Honey & 10ml Dijon Mustard

instructions.title: COOK YOUR GRAIN
instructions.text: Rinse the quinoa and place in a pot with the stock. Submerge in 400ml of water and stir through. Place over a medium-high heat and bring to a simmer uncovered. Cook for 12-15 minutes until the quinoa is tender and its tails have popped out, adding more water if required during the cooking process. On completion, drain if necessary and return to the pot. Cover with a lid and allow to stand off the heat for at least 5 minutes.

instructions.title: TOAST THE SEEDS
instructions.text: Place the pumpkin seeds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until they begin to pop and brown. On completion, remove from the pan and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: PICKLE & PESTO
instructions.text: In a salad bowl, combine the Dijon dressing with 2 tsp of oil, a pinch of salt, and a small splash of warm water. Toss through the quartered baby tomatoes and set aside to pickle. Place ½ of the red pesto in a small bowl with 2 tsp of oil. Loosen with water in 5ml increments until drizzling consistency and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: STRIPS OF BABY MARROW
instructions.text: Slice the trimmed baby marrow lengthways into 1cm thick strips. Return the pan (or use a grill pan if you have one) to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the baby marrow for 2-3 minutes per side until lightly charred. Remove from the pan on completion, season, and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: FRY UP THE HALLOUMI
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with another drizzle of oil if necessary. When hot, fry the halloumi slabs for 1-2 minutes per side until crispy and golden. Remove on completion and allow to drain on some paper towel. Just before serving, add the marinated tomatoes to the pot of quinoa and toss together with the Dijon dressing to taste. Mix through the other ½ of the red pesto until coated. Cut the baby marrow into bite-size chunks.

instructions.title: A GORGEOUS VEGGIE JUMBLE!
instructions.text: Make a bed of rinsed green leaves and top with the quinoa, baby marrow, and golden halloumi. Finish off with the toasted pumpkin seeds, the mint leaves, and drizzles of red pesto dressing. Nice one, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: To make the salad dressing, place the ingredients in a clean jar, close the lid up tight, and shake, shake, shake! Using a jar emulsifies the dressing much more successfully than just mixing it in a bowl!

recipes.title: Higgs' Ambrosial Aubergine Ravioli
recipes.subtitle: with ricotta, sun-dried tomato & sage
recipes.description: Sweet sun-dried tomato & aubergine ravioli, rounded off with fresh zesty ricotta and crispy sage – traditional flavours that you just can't beat. The trick of this dish is to cook the aubergine to perfection, the rest just rolls out from there.

instructions.title: AWESOME AUBS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the aubergine chunks on a roasting tray, coat in oil, season and evenly spread out, skin-side down. Roast in the hot oven for 20-25 minutes, shifting occasionally, until soft.

instructions.title: LEMON-SAGE RICOTTA
instructions.text: Bring a pot (for the ravioli) of salted water to the boil. Roughly slice ½ of the picked sage leaves. Combine the ricotta with lemon zest – to taste, the sliced sage, a drizzle of oil, and season. When the aubergine has 10 minutes to go, toss ½ the lemon-sage ricotta through the aubergine and return to the oven. This will help caramelise the aubergine and give the ricotta a slightly smoky taste.

instructions.title: BOILED & DRESSED
instructions.text: When the water is boiling, cook the ravioli for 2-3 minutes until al dente. Drain on completion. Gently toss through some oil to prevent sticking. Set aside. Place the rinsed green leaves in a bowl and toss with a drizzle of oil and seasoning.

instructions.title: TOASTING
instructions.text: Place a pan (large enough for the ravioli) over a medium heat with the sunflower seeds. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden. Remove from the pan and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: CRISP FINISH
instructions.text: When the ravioli is done, return the pan to a medium-high heat with a knob of butter and a drizzle of oil. When the butter foams, fry the whole sage leaves, some lemon juice (to taste), and the ravioli in a single layer for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden, gently shaking the pan regularly to prevent sticking. Add the roasted ricotta-aubergine, the remaining fresh ricotta and the chopped sun-dried tomatoes. Toss to combine and season to taste.

instructions.title: RAVISHING RAVIOLI
instructions.text: Dish up the ravioli. Top with green leaves. Garnish with the toasted sunflower seeds. Drizzle over some balsamic glaze. There you have it!

recipes.title: Heaped Halloumi Tabbouleh
recipes.subtitle: with a honey-harissa dressing, baby spinach & fresh parsley
recipes.description: A Levantine bulgur wheat salad with a crispy cannellini twirl! Baby spinach, tomatoes, and cucumber crank up the volume to get this halloumi boogie going. Add a sweet and spicy harissa dressing, and you'll be drooling at the stove!

instructions.title: COOK THE BULGUR
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Using a shallow bowl, submerge the bulgur & stock mix in 800ml of boiling water. Add a drizzle of oil and gently stir through with a fork. Cover with a plate and set aside to steam for 15-20 minutes until cooked and tender. Fluff up with the fork on completion, replace the plate, and set aside.

instructions.title: CRISPY CANNELLINIS
instructions.text: Place a large pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, toast the drained cannellini beans for 12-15 minutes until crispy and caramel in colour. For the best results, only shift occasionally. Season on completion and transfer to a bowl. Cover to keep warm and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: WHILE THE BEANS ARE FRYING...
instructions.text: Mix the dressing and toss the salad! In a bowl, whisk together the sweet harissa dressing, 1 tbsp of olive oil, and a splash of water. Whisk in the white wine vinegar to taste and set aside. Place the quartered baby tomatoes and cucumber half-moons in a large salad bowl. Toss together with three-quarters of the chopped parsley, a pinch of salt, and a drizzle of olive oil.

instructions.title: IT'S ALL COMING TOGETHER!
instructions.text: Once the bulgur wheat is cooked, add it to the salad bowl and pour in half of the harissa dressing. Toss until coated and evenly distributed, and set aside for serving.

instructions.title: SPICED UP HALLOUMI
instructions.text: Coat the halloumi slabs in oil and the African Rub to taste. Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the halloumi for 1-2 minutes per side until crispy and golden. Remove from the pan on completion and allow to drain on some paper towel. Try not to eat it all before serving! When cool enough to handle, cut into bite-size chunks. Toss the rinsed baby spinach with a drizzle of oil and some seasoning.

instructions.title: TABBOULEH TIME
instructions.text: Make a bed of baby spinach and load up with the delish tabbouleh. Scatter over the cannellini beans and top with the fragrant halloumi. Drizzle over the remaining harissa dressing to taste and garnish with the remaining chopped parsley. Look at that, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: To make the harissa salad dressing, place all the ingredients in a clean jar, close the lid tight, and shake, shake, shake! Using a jar emulsifies the dressing much more successfully than just mixing it in a bowl!

recipes.title: Tasty Butternut & Ricotta Ravioli
recipes.subtitle: with aubergine & balsamic reduction
recipes.description: Did you know that the word 'ravioli' comes from an old Italian word that means 'to wrap'? Well, today, you're going to wrap your taste buds around these fluffy filled pillows of deliciousness. Butternut & ricotta ravioli are combined with roasted aubergine, tangy tomatoes, fresh greens, peppery basil & completed with a creamy crème fraîche dressing.

ingredients.name: Aubergine
ingredients.prep: rinsed, trimmed & cut into bite-sized chunks

instructions.title: AWESOME AUBS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the aubergine chunks on a roasting tray, skin-side down. Coat in oil, season, and spread out evenly. Roast in the hot oven for 20-25 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally.

instructions.title: GOLDEN SEEDS
instructions.text: Place a pan, large enough for the ravioli, over a medium heat with the sunflower seeds. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden. Remove from the pan and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: BOIL THE RAVI-ONLY
instructions.text: Bring a pot (for the ravioli) of salted water to the boil. When the water is boiling, cook the ravioli for 2-3 minutes until al dente. Drain and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: ALWAYS BETTER WITH BUTTER
instructions.text: When the ravioli is done, return the pan to a medium-high heat with 60g of butter and a drizzle of oil. When the butter foams, add the lemon juice (to taste), and the ravioli, in a single layer. Fry for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden, gently shaking the pan regularly to prevent sticking. Set aside.

instructions.title: TIME TO COMBINE
instructions.text: Loosen the crème fraîche with water in 5ml increments until drizzling consistency. Set aside. In a salad bowl, combine the fried ravioli, the aubergine chunks, the diced tomatoes, the shredded salad leaves, seasoning, and ½ the torn basil.

instructions.title: DELICIOUS DINNER!
instructions.text: Plate up the loaded ravioli salad and drizzle over the loosened crème fraîche and the balsamic reduction. Scatter over the toasted pumpkin seeds and garnish with the remaining basil.

recipes.obscured_details: Binder ring hole punch punches through and obscures the protein value (in grams) in the Nutritional Information table.

recipes.title: Golden Halloumi & Pesto Bake
recipes.subtitle: with yellow bell pepper, baby marrow & basmati rice
recipes.description: Juicy tomato, sweet yellow bell peppers, bright green baby marrow, and golden halloumi all dance together in this warm and flavourful veggie dish! Served with pesto-doused brown basmati rice for extra flair, you will never believe how gloriously tasty rice and veggies can be!

ingredients.name: Yellow Bell Pepper
ingredients.prep: rinsed, deseeded & cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Baby Marrow
ingredients.prep: rinsed, trimmed & cut into bite-sized chunks

instructions.title: RICE, RICE BABY
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the rice and place in a pot over a medium-high heat. Submerge in 500ml of salted water and pop on a lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and set aside to steam for a further 10 minutes. On completion, drain if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: ROAST WITH THE MOST
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Spread out the pepper pieces, the baby marrow chunks, the rinsed chickpeas, and the tomato wedges on a roasting tray. Coat in oil, the rub, and seasoning. Pour in 80ml of boiling water and bake in the hot oven for 15-20 minutes, until the veggies have browned.

instructions.title: THE ANGEL'S HALLO-UMI
instructions.text: When the roast has 5-10 minutes remaining, place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the halloumi slabs and fry for 1-2 minutes per side until crispy and golden. On completion, drain on some paper towel. Loosen the pesto with oil in 5ml increments until a drizzling consistency.

instructions.title: THE GREAT HALLOUMI BAKE OFF!
instructions.text: Plate up the fluffy rice. Pile on the roasted veg and chickpeas. Drizzle over any tray juices. Top with the golden halloumi and spoon over the loosened pesto. Sprinkle with the torn basil and dig in, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: Grains like rice, quinoa, and barley should be rinsed thoroughly with cold water before cooking to remove excess starch. All in all, rinsing improves taste, texture, and cleanliness!

recipes.title: Mamma Mia Ravioli
recipes.subtitle: with a rainbow pomodoro sauce, bocconcini & fresh basil
recipes.description: Pomodoro means "tomato" in Italian. Here, piquanté peppers, garlic, and a rainbow medley of baby tomatoes come together with flair to smother mouthwatering morsels of spinach and ricotta ravioli and balls of soft Italian cheese.

instructions.title: START WITH THE SEEDS
instructions.text: Place the pumpkin seeds in a large pot over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until they begin to pop and turn brown. Remove from the pot on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: RAINBOW POMODORO SAUCE
instructions.text: Return the pot to a low-medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add in the grated garlic, rinsed baby tomatoes, and chopped piquanté peppers. Give a stir and pop on a lid. Cook for 8-10 minutes until the tomatoes are soft, using your cooking utensil to break them up as they cook. Take care not to spatter yourself with hot juice! If the sauce becomes too dry, add in another drizzle of oil or a knob of butter. On completion, season to taste and set aside in a bowl. Wipe down the pot and set aside for step 4.

instructions.title: BOIL THE RAVIOLI
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Fill a second pot with boiling water, add a generous pinch of salt, and place over a medium-high heat. Once boiling rapidly, cook the ravioli for 3-4 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain on completion.

instructions.title: CRISP THE RAVIOLI
instructions.text: Return the pot used for the sauce to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and a knob of butter. Once foaming, fry the ravioli in a single layer for 4-5 minutes until crispy and golden, tossing occasionally. Do this step in batches if necessary, adding more butter in between each batch. On completion, return all of the ravioli to the pan.

instructions.title: ALL TOGETHER NOW!
instructions.text: Keeping the pot on the heat, add in the pomodoro sauce. Cook for 3-4 minutes until heated through, gently tossing to coat the ravioli. Remove from the heat and stir in half of the shredded basil and half of the bocconcini halves. Finally, add some more seasoning if necessary. Toss a drizzle of oil through the rinsed rocket and baby spinach.

instructions.title: BOWL UP
instructions.text: Stock up with mouthwatering ravioli al pomodoro. Scatter over the remaining shredded basil, the toasted pumpkin seeds, and the remaining bocconcini. Serve the dressed leaves on the side with drizzles of balsamic glaze. Buon appetito!

recipes.chef_tip: Boil the ravioli in batches to prevent crowding the pot and overcooking.

recipes.title: Green Goddess Camembert Salad
recipes.subtitle: with tart green apple, crunchy walnuts & creamy guacamole
recipes.description: Sweet dreams are made of greens! Crumbed camembert tossed with peas, salad leaves, chickpeas and coated in our famous Green Goddess dressing: yoghurt, guacamole, and raspberry vinegar. Walnuts and fresh apples finish off this fresh dish with a divine crunch!

instructions.title: HOT CHICK
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the drained chickpeas on a roasting tray. Coat in oil and seasoning. Spread out in a single layer and roast in the hot oven for 15-20 minutes until crispy, shifting at the halfway mark.

instructions.title: WAL STREET
instructions.text: Place the walnuts in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until browned, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan and roughly chop.

instructions.title: GET DRESSED!
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the guacamole and the yoghurt. Gradually loosen with milk or water in 30ml increments until drizzling consistency. Pour in the raspberry vinegar (to taste), seasoning, and mix until combined.

instructions.title: GRIN AND CAMEMBERT IT
instructions.text: In a shallow dish, combine the breadcrumbs and the rub (seasoned lightly). Prepare another shallow dish with 1 egg whisked with 1 tbsp of water. Dip each camembert slice into the egg, and then lightly coat in the breadcrumbs. Return the pan to a medium-high heat with enough oil to coat the base. When hot, fry the crumbed camembert for 1 minute each side, until golden brown. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towel.

instructions.title: LET'S ASSEMBLE!
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Submerge the peas in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until plump and heated through. Drain on completion and place in a salad bowl. Cut the rinsed apple into cubes and place in the salad bowl with the peas. Add the salad leaves, ½ the crispy chickpeas and ½ the green goddess dressing. Toss until fully coated.

instructions.title: FEAST LIKE A GODDESS
instructions.text: Bowl up a portion of crunchy salad. Top with the crispy camembert and drizzle over the remaining green goddess dressing. Garnish with the remaining chickpeas, chopped parsley, and chopped walnuts. Gorgeous!

recipes.obscured_details: Protein value in Nutritional Information is obscured/punched out by the binder ring hole.

recipes.title: Ricotta Ravioli & Sage Butter
recipes.subtitle: with Italian-style hard cheese, baby spinach & toasted hazelnuts
recipes.description: These pasta pockets are bursting with butternut and ricotta, swished with baby spinach, and dripping in garlic and sage beurre noisette or "browned butter", with its famous nutty aroma. Classy, comforting, and quick!

instructions.title: TOASTY HAZELNUTS
instructions.text: Boil the kettle for step 3. Place a large, nonstick pan over a medium heat. When hot, toast the hazelnuts for 5-6 minutes until golden, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside. Roughly chop when cool enough to handle.

instructions.title: CRISP THE CANNELLINIS
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, toast the drained cannellini beans for 12-15 minutes until crispy and caramel in colour. At the halfway mark, stir through the Italian Rub to taste. For the best results, only shift occasionally. On completion, remove from the heat and set aside until serving.

instructions.title: BOIL THE RAVIOLI
instructions.text: Place a pot for the ravioli over a high heat. Fill with boiling water and add a pinch of salt. Once boiling rapidly, cook the ravioli for 2-3 minutes until they begin to float and are heated through. Drain on completion and toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: SAGE BEURRE NOISETTE
instructions.text: Place another large pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil or knob of butter. When hot, fry the ravioli in a single layer until crisp and golden. You may need to do this step in batches. Remove from the pan on completion, return the pan to the heat, and add in 120g of butter. Once foaming, spread the rinsed sage leaves across the pan in a single layer. Fry for 2-3 minutes until the leaves are crispy and the butter has a nutty aroma, watching closely. Reduce to a medium heat, add the grated garlic, and sauté for about a minute. Add in the ravioli, half of the chopped hazelnuts, half of the rinsed baby spinach, and the juice of 4 lemon wedges. Toss until coated, remove the pan from the heat, and season to taste.

instructions.title: RESTAURANT-QUALITY DINNER
instructions.text: Lay out the remaining fresh baby spinach and cover with three-quarters of the cannellinis. Top with the buttery pockets of ravioli and all of the sauce from the pan. Sprinkle with the grated hard cheese, the remaining toasted hazelnuts, and the lemon zest to taste. Finally, scatter the remaining cannellinis over the lot. Delectable, Chef!

recipes.chef_tip: Beurre noisette translates to "brown butter" or "hazelnut butter". It's a popular sauce in French cuisine where butter is slightly burnt in a pan, giving it a nutty, sweet aroma. It's a stunning sauce for pastas, steaks, steamed or blanched and fish.
